You can't have a democracy without voting -- period, end of story, full stop. Saying that "voting isn't a fundamental right" is basically admitting that your state isn't a real democracy. Kansas told its citizens that with this decision, regardless of the legalese they used.
This isn't just a step backward for Kansas, it's a step backward for our country. Fuel our efforts to fight rulings like this and pass pro-democracy, pro-voter legislation that defends our right to vote with $25 or more right now >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=110224_4&amount=25]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=110224_4&amount=25]
Witchita Eagle: Kansas Supreme Court finds Kansans have no ‘fundamental right’ to vote [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=110224_4&amount=25]
Sit down before you read this, Team: The Kansas Supreme Court has ruled that voting is not a fundamental right protected by the Kansas Constitution .
It should go without saying, but this decision will likely weaken legal challenges to future voting restrictions in Kansas and make it easier for opponents of voting rights in their legislature to more aggressively pursue new anti-voting laws.
Hang with us while we explain how they split hairs on this decision, but -- the Kansas Supreme Court said voting is a " political right " and not a " fundamental right ". What's the difference? With a fundamental right, the government has to prove why it needs to pass new voting laws and restrictions. With a political right, the onus is on the voters to prove they are being unreasonably burdened and blocked from voting.
In short -- this decision reads like a " get out of jail free " card from Monopoly, granting a legal wink and a nudge to opponents of voting rights to make it harder to vote.
Voter suppression anywhere hurts us everywhere. Help us defend the right to vote with $25 or whatever you can today in states like Kansas where our democracy is under threat >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=110224_4&amount=25]

Fellow patriot,

I’m writing today to speak about a man who has the courage, vision, and relentless grit we need in the U.S. Senate –**Bernie Moreno.**

I’ve had the honor of serving our nation as Secretary of State and Director of the CIA under President Donald J. Trump. I know what it takes to defend the ideals that make America great. We need leaders in the Senate who understand what’s at stake and won’t flinch in the face of growing threats at home and abroad. **Bernie has an iron will – he’s a fighter who will _never_ back down. **

For too long, weak and feckless Democrats like Sherrod Brown have compromised our nation from the inside out – open borders, out-of-control spending, radical left policies that threaten our national security. Bernie Moreno will take the fight head-on, working to put America first – ensuring our country's strength on the world stage.

Bernie was born in Bogota, Colombia. At age five, his American Dream began when he moved to the United States with his family. Bernie became an American citizen at age 18.

Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America.

In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board.

After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation.

Solving our country’s problems requires common sense. In Washington, Bernie will fight to shrink government, protect our freedoms, stop the Chinese Communist party from taking our data and land, and always put America First.

Ohioans are done with politicians who talk a big game and do nothing. Bernie wants to go to D.C. to get work done – just like he always has.

| | | | | Friend,
**3 Days To Go!**
Today #TeamMackenzie welcomed some special guests to help fire up our volunteers before they went out door knocking. But our volunteers didn’t really need firing up because they know something: the momentum is on our side. You can feel it. And it’s because of those volunteers that we are finishing strong. I cannot thank them enough for the time and energy they are giving to help us win!
While we have attracted volunteers from every corner of the 7th District, the Wild campaign is busing in people from NEW YORK to do their work because they don’t have grassroots support. But that makes it all the more important that we finish strong.
**Tomorrow (Sunday)** will be nice weather, and we need your help to take this campaign across the finish line. Below are a few opportunities - one in Lehigh County and one in Northampton County - to help us on a massive door-knocking blitz.
**Sunday 11/3/2024: 2:00 PM; Doors and/or Phones** ; Location: Mackenzie HQ 1125 S Cedar Crest Blvd. Allentown PA (bottom floor)
**Sunday 11/3/2024: 2:00 PM; Door-to-Door** ; Location: Northampton County Republican Committee 2523 Willow Park Rd, Bethlehem, PA
We will also be doing phone-banking on Monday at campaign HQ, and welcome you to stop in and help...
**Monday 11/4/2024:** ALL DAY Office open from 9:30 AM to 8:00 PM Location: Mackenzie HQ 1125 S Cedar Crest Blvd. Allentown PA (bottom floor)
Finally, there are still slots available to work on Election Day at the polls...
**Tuesday, 11/5/2024 - ELECTION DAY:** If you have not contacted Sara yet about poll greeting on election day, please call her at 484-860-5989 or stop into the Mackenzie HQ office at the times listed above.
**If you can give any amount of time tomorrow, Monday, or Tuesday, it will help us win this seat and bring real change to Congress.** I hope we can count on your support!
No matter what, make sure you vote by either returning your mail-in ballot to a drop box or county elections office or showing up at the polls on Tuesday!

| | I am very proud to announce that Senator Gloria Romero (Ret.) has endorsed my campaign for Congress.

Romero stated, “David Pan is committed to fighting for school choice and parents’ rights so that all parents can have the possibility of choosing the best options for their children’s education. We need his voice in Congress to help open up real possibilities for working families to improve their children’s lives.”

As an educator, I understand what a difference a quality education can make in a young person’s life. By creating a government monopoly on education in the public school system, we have trapped children in failing schools and left them without alternatives. If we can establish charter schools as an alternative to neighborhood public schools, we are offering parents the ability to make choices about the best way to build their children’s future. Offering school vouchers to allow all parents to pay for private schools would further provide their children with the same opportunities that are currently only reserved for the wealthy.

Yes, some public schools would lose students and may have to close, but only if parents decide that those schools are not serving their children well. In this process, new opportunities would open up for both teachers and students to all thrive in alternative institutions. Expanding the kinds of schools available to all children will improve education overall. In fact, studies of Florida’s school voucher program have shown that children from all schools, including public schools, have improved their test scores in the new system.

Help me to create the best future for our children.

Please vote for me, tell your family and friends, and donate at
[DavidPanforCongress.com](https://eot.davidpanforcongress.org/f/a/rQFIS6fSXHmMrvrLfCVlIg~~/AAAHUQA~/RgRpCU-4P0UgZTQ2YzQwMDc3NDk3ZGM3NDU5ZjFiZWRmYWQ3NzZjYWNEHmh0dHA6Ly9EYXZpZFBhbmZvckNvbmdyZXNzLmNvbVcFc3BjZXVCCmcOuMomZ9cgERZSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAGud).

Thanks!

#
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83392?refcode=em20241102-8606&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=8606%2E614464%2EYqsBvO)
Hey Peter, it’s Jon Hamm.
There’s an important U.S. Senate race happening in my home state this year that I think you need to know about.
So before I ask you to support my friend Lucas Kunce’s campaign to defeat Josh Hawley and flip Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat, please let me explain why no one can afford to sit on the sidelines in this race.
**[DEFEAT JOSH HAWLEY](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83392?refcode=em20241102-8606&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=8606%2E614464%2EYqsBvO)**
Let’s start at the beginning. When I first got to know Lucas, his story resonated with me. He’s a born-and-raised Missourian who knows the real value of community — helping each other out, for better or for worse.
Growing up, his parents went bankrupt from his youngest sister’s medical bills and his family survived on the support of their friends and neighbors. After getting to college on a Pell Grant, Lucas decided to join the U.S. Marine Corps to honor the community that had given his family so much. He served for 13 years, including three deployments to Iraq and Afghanistan before later being stationed at the Pentagon.
Once he left active duty, Lucas turned his focus to the corrupt politicians and corporate monopolies that dominate our economy and squeeze small businesses. He took on everyone from Big Tech and Big Ag to defense contractors and pharmaceutical companies.
**Now, Lucas is running to defeat January 6th coward Josh Hawley and take back Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat for real, everyday people.**
**[ELECT LUCAS KUNCE](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83392?refcode=em20241102-8606&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=8606%2E614464%2EYqsBvO)**
Let’s just be clear here: Hawley’s January 6th cowardice isn’t the only reason he’s incapable of representing my home state.
**

Truth be told, I had a blast covering **President Trump** 's rally for **RSBN** which is a great network.
However, it was a _little weird_ putting on a press pass and being stationed next to **CNN** , **ABC** , **NBC** and etc... it felt like I had joined the dark side.
What was **REALLY** weird was when **President Trump** pointed out the fake news and the entire crowd turned around and started shouting and booing at us in the press box. I wanted to shout back, _"I am one of the good guys!"_ haha
It has been a great journey this election cycle and if you have not already voted, make sure on Tuesday that you **VOTE**!
Thank you,
Pastor Jackson Lahmeyer

subject: WORKING LINK: Sunday and Monday opportunities to volunteer across Pennsylvania!
body:
| | |
---
| | Hi Friend ,

We are at the home stretch and many of you have said they want an opportunity to help do something, so here it is. As you know, we have agreed to knock on more than 40,000 doors across Pennsylvania ahead of the Nov, 5th election, and you can join too!We will provide the training and door hangers. Plus, all volunteers will be paired with a staff member.
---
| |
---
| **Several shifts are available in Chester County, Delaware County, Montgomery County, Erie, Harrisburg, and Pittsburgh!** Training will take place during the first 30 minutes of the shift. We will use the MiniVAN app (blue icon with dots in a circle). Please download it before arriving.Wear bright colors, especially if volunteering in the afternoon. name: OKGOP
subject: Daylight Saving? We need grocery bill savings!
body:
| [ ](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=urG6o0YzHACIJY0G92IOaIOiUFGhm1XQHaiZ59fvCoY&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_daylight_saving_we_need_groc&n=1)
---
Peter, don’t forget to set your clocks back tonight for Daylight Saving Time...But going back one hour isn’t enough, we need to go back 4 years to when we had low gas prices, low energy bills, & low grocery costs! And there’s a way we can do that: **vote straight party Republican when you vote this Tuesday, November 5th!!!** Four years ago we had a booming economy with low prices, and we can once again. Oklahoma Republicans at the State Capitol eliminated the state grocery tax this year to bring about some relief, but to truly be booming again we need to unleash the free markets, get back to energy independence, & cut regulations across ALL levels of government. That means from the Presidency down to the county level. And the surest way to do that is to get Republicans at all levels of government by voting straight party Republican. But there’s even more on your Tuesday ballot to vote on. Just as important (and possibly even MORE important) is the vote on 3 Oklahoma Supreme Court judges. We **MUST VOTE NO** in order to remove these liberal judges from our court. Over the last few years we’ve all seen the lawfare happening in the judicial system. We’ve see the courts legislating from the bench & forcing their leftist views on the people. We’ve experienced the attacks by those in their black robes who believe they can dictate their views on everyone else. And we now have the power to stop it by **VOTING NO on all three Supreme Court judges** on the ballot. Do you know what the difference is between Oklahoma Judge Kauger & Congresswoman Nancy Pelosi? Well, Judge Kauger has been on the Supreme Court LONGER than Nancy Pelosi has been in Congress! And that’s the only real difference because when it comes to ideology they are almost identical. We don’t need someone pushing California-style liberal policies to be sitting on OUR Oklahoma Supreme Court at all, let alone for decades! But it’s not just Kauger with far-left views. **Judges Edmondson, Gurich, & Kauger are ALL extremely liberal**. They were all appointed by Democrat governors forever ago. And they all have constantly legislated from the bench to force their leftist agenda on Oklahoma.
### So remember to VOTE NO on all three Supreme Court judges.
Simply put: they must go, so we must **VOTE NO!** Spread the word. Tell everyone you know to vote NO on all three Supreme Court judges. That’s the only way to ensure Oklahomans keep their liberties and keep more of their hard earned money in their pockets. -Team OKGOP

This email was sent to [dpwillis67@gmail.com](mailto:dpwillis67@gmail.com). To stop receiving emails, [click here](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/unsubscribe?e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_daylight_saving_we_need_groc&n=2).
You can also keep up with OKGOP on [Twitter](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=JcrYNQ7dhdufXPgOgJxNGHSsRONv6mnq7ly6aBOUvGVprSj7jfHNOpP70kR_1QLA&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_daylight_saving_we_need_groc&n=3) or [Facebook](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=UQNagEd-DqbIXa37T8ODid9mG9NGbq3z9te4_riKc6EaGmrOrRzKc2wAaVTFbzRY&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_daylight_saving_we_need_groc&n=4).

clean_body: Peter, I’m an actress, director, singer, longtime activist, and, above all, a citizen of our great democracy. And as a citizen with a platform larger than most, I believe it is not only my right but also my duty to express my concerns. So here goes Peter: I’m concerned by what I’m seeing in Pennsylvania and national Republicans’ ruthless efforts to unseat Bob Casey and flip this battleground red. If the GOP succeeds in flipping Pennsylvania red, they’ll almost certainly regain control of both the Senate and the White House, threatening everything from voting rights to women’s rights to the fight against climate change. That’s why outside interest groups are spending upwards of $150 million to defeat Bob. The stakes this November are higher than ever before. I’m committed to electing lawmakers like Bob Casey, who believes that everyone deserves a fair shot at getting ahead and staying ahead. Bob’s opponent on the other hand is a Connecticut mega-millionaire who will do and say anything to help his own bottom line. With the most extreme Republican party of my lifetime teetering on the edge of regaining power, we need all hands on deck. If we’re going to protect our Senate majority and the White House, we must all stay informed and stay involved. Thank you, Barbra Barbra Streisand

Dear Democrats,
I want to share a few words as we go into the final weekend before Election Day.
Firstly, thank you. Thank you for being a part of our people-powered movement here in California. Thank you for your generous contributions, your volunteering hours, or even just taking the time to read our emails and stay up-to-date on current events.
It has been the honor of my life to serve as Executive Director of the California Democratic Party. And we’ve accomplished so much.
We wanted to stop just rushing organizing programs together before an election, and instead establish a Forever Organizing Program that would start mobilizing communities months and years ahead of Election Day.
We wanted to open regional offices sooner than ever, so that volunteers could have a place to do the work of reaching undecided voters.
We wanted to hire more organizing staff and expand our Voter Protection Hotline in an effort to reach as many eligible voters as possible with information on how to vote.
We wanted to do all these things. And we did. Not because of dark money. Because of you.
Now, we are moving into the final days (and hours!) of the election. And we are still going full-throttle, pushing our teams to leave it all on the field.
I want to make sure I have the discretionary budget necessary to support our organizers and volunteers. That’s why, for the last time this election, I am asking you to make a donation on my personal ActBlue link.

I know many of you have donated before. I know you are getting lots of emails and texts. But that will all come to a stop shortly. Until then, let’s not leave anything undone.
Because when we organize, we win. Let’s do this.
Yours, ever sincerely,
- Yvette

In rural areas, political yard signs take the place of polls.
Voters drive down winding county roads and count the signs for each candidate. On that basis, they either gloat or despair. Or curse.
In Warren County, New York, it is estimated that some 247 signs for Democratic candidates or for the New York Equal Rights Amendment (Proposition 1) have been taken.
Other counties report thefts.
That I know of, there have been no thefts of signs of Republican candidates, nor of their signs of opposition to Prop 1. Please let me know if you have heard of Republican signs being stolen. Maybe I'm over-thinking this. Maybe I'm being too quick to blame a particular party of wrongdoing.
I live several counties over from Warren County. Full disclosure, the need to front the money to place another sign order, combined with the lead time it takes for delivery, made the theft of our signs in certain areas devastating. My team also did not think we had time to drive 3 hours to Warren County, deliver the signs, and drive back, given all of the other events in our schedule last week. In other words, we could have sunk precious dollars into ordering more signs, but we were unsure of the efficacy of ordering signs only to have them arrive late last week and then not be able to get them to Warren County homes until late Saturday night.
On Sunday, November 3, Warren County Democrats will spring into action. Here is the announcement from Facebook: "Let's line Glen Street to let Glens Falls and Queensbury know that we won't go back!! Vote YES for Harris/Walz and vote YES on Proposition 1 to protect equal rights in the NYS Constitution. This Sunday, meet on the sidewalk on Glen Street in front of the Glens Falls YMCA at 3:30pm, or meet at the Graycourt Motel at 1082 US-9, Queensbury, NY 12804, and we'll spread out from those two locations. Bring your signs (if you have any left!) or make ones to bring!"
We will be there with some of our home made signs, as well as a few "Cats for Collins" signs that we held back as mementos.
And remember: you can steal our signs, but you can't steal our votes.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b4c4d1f0-cb8c-462e-bb76-1fc71ce6a613?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_____________________________________________________
I have to say, Ken Tingley's October 30, 2024 column, ["Would you be willing to do what Navalny did?"](https://substack.com/redirect/58f815ed-e657-4b0c-8fde-20ab8e7b8ee1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) has worked its way into my idle thoughts as we drive the remaining miles of the 2024 Congressional campaign.
Trump has [promised to prosecute or punish his enemies if he gets elected](https://substack.com/redirect/a847b224-1638-4323-86bb-59ba67988c91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). My hunch is that he will also attempt to wreak havoc if he doesn't get elected as well, though I sincerely hope he will be too busy fighting to stay out of prison to do so.
Did you forget? [Trump is due in court for sentencing on November 26, 2024.](https://substack.com/redirect/cfe86571-beb3-4224-b47f-5686ac1adb2c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Presumably this date will be moved, or his sentence deferred, if he gets re-elected.
What happens if we don't have a result by November 26, 2024?
Never mind. Don't answer. Nobody really knows. We've never been down this path before.
I honestly could not fathom how the FBI did not take action last week when Trump suggested that [former Congresswoman Liz Cheney, daughter of former Vice President Dick Cheney, should face "nine barrels shooting at her" with guns "trained on her face". ](https://substack.com/redirect/c0d73081-23ff-42ff-a062-c7079c68019b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Who says this sort of thing about anybody? In what universe is this acceptable rhetoric from a presidential candidate?
The remark was made in Arizona during a taping of an interview with Tucker Carlson. Arizona Attorney General Kris Mayes, a Democrat who won her seat in 2023 with a margin of only 280 votes, [is analyzing the remarks to see if they qualify as death threats under Arizona law. ](https://substack.com/redirect/4e2ae6f9-a665-40bb-84a3-5478196bf067?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
In a refreshing change, [Fox News reported that Harris called the remarks "disqualifying". ](https://substack.com/redirect/c0d73081-23ff-42ff-a062-c7079c68019b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Thank you, Fox. You could have chosen to ignore the remark, but you didn't.
I won't even analyze the [Trump mock sex act](https://substack.com/redirect/fa0aa98e-77db-427b-a916-f14a8ef3e70a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with the microphone that happened on Friday. No, I haven't seen the video. If I see the video, I will never be able to un-see the video.
Stefanik as Surrogate has not spoken out to distance herself from any of this behavior, which I find to be disqualifying of her candidacy. By the way, that expression, "surrogate" is her term, not mine. See her [Facebook post here](https://substack.com/redirect/adc9ae43-d4f3-4102-a2cf-73f5000eac45?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
The thought that lurks in the dark corners of my mind is that I have been Elise Stefanik's opponent on the 2024 ballot. Exactly how far does the list of enemies go? Will enemies of Trump surrogates also face retribution?
Never mind. It's too late. I'm on the ballot. And I sure as heck can't go back. (Cue the chant: "We're not going back!)
I'm going forward and continuing my call for Elise Stefanik to resign from office immediately. Stefanik has broken the oath she swore to protect and defend the U.S. Constitution from enemies foreign and domestic.
Those enemies within, that the MAGAs talk about.
Stefanik's campaign hub is not in New York State. The focus of her campaign activity is in Charlottesville, Virginia, at the Trump Winery, where she is in charge of "Women for Trump."
That literally takes jobs out of the North Country.
Jobs as political consultants.
Jobs as campaign field operators.
Jobs as political staff members.
Jobs in political tech.
Jobs as interns.
None of those jobs are in the North Country in Elise Stefanik's campaign office.
None of those jobs have been created for our North Country men and women, most of them in college or freshly out of college, to take.
For that reason, Stefanik should immediately suspend her campaign for re-election.
Locating the hub of your campaign activity outside of the state (much less outside of the district) is disqualifying.
Each minute brings us closer to the close of polls on Election Night, November 5, 2024.
I'm starting my race for the midterms on November 6, 2024.
In the words of Alexy Navalny, "You are not allowed to give up."

clean_body: In rural areas, political yard signs take the place of polls. | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more NY-21 Updates on the Congressional Race * | | | Nov 3 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- In rural areas, political yard signs take the place of polls. Voters drive down winding county roads and count the signs for each candidate. On that basis, they either gloat or despair. Or curse. In Warren County, New York, it is estimated that some 247 signs for Democratic candidates or for the New York Equal Rights Amendment (Proposition 1) have been taken. Other counties report thefts. That I know of, there have been no thefts of signs of Republican candidates, nor of their signs of opposition to Prop 1. Please let me know if you have heard of Republican signs being stolen. Maybe I'm over-thinking this. Maybe I'm being too quick to blame a particular party of wrongdoing. I live several counties over from Warren County. Full disclosure, the need to front the money to place another sign order, combined with the lead time it takes for delivery, made the theft of our signs in certain areas devastating. My team also did not think we had time to drive 3 hours to Warren County, deliver the signs, and drive back, given all of the other events in our schedule last week. In other words, we could have sunk precious dollars into ordering more signs, but we were unsure of the efficacy of ordering signs only to have them arrive late last week and then not be able to get them to Warren County homes until late Saturday night. On Sunday, November 3, Warren County Democrats will spring into action. Here is the announcement from Facebook: "Let's line Glen Street to let Glens Falls and Queensbury know that we won't go back!! Vote YES for Harris/Walz and vote YES on Proposition 1 to protect equal rights in the NYS Constitution. This Sunday, meet on the sidewalk on Glen Street in front of the Glens Falls YMCA at 3:30pm, or meet at the Graycourt Motel at 1082 US-9, Queensbury, NY 12804, and we'll spread out from those two locations. Bring your signs (if you have any left!) or make ones to bring!" We will be there with some of our home made signs, as well as a few "Cats for Collins" signs that we held back as mementos. And remember: you can steal our signs, but you can't steal our votes. | | ---|---|--- I have to say, Ken Tingley's October 30, 2024 column, has worked its way into my idle thoughts as we drive the remaining miles of the 2024 Congressional campaign. Trump has . My hunch is that he will also attempt to wreak havoc if he doesn't get elected as well, though I sincerely hope he will be too busy fighting to stay out of prison to do so. Did you forget? Presumably this date will be moved, or his sentence deferred, if he gets re-elected. What happens if we don't have a result by November 26, 2024? Never mind. Don't answer. Nobody really knows. We've never been down this path before. I honestly could not fathom how the FBI did not take action last week when Trump suggested that Who says this sort of thing about anybody? In what universe is this acceptable rhetoric from a presidential candidate? The remark was made in Arizona during a taping of an interview with Tucker Carlson. Arizona Attorney General Kris Mayes, a Democrat who won her seat in 2023 with a margin of only 280 votes, In a refreshing change, Thank you, Fox. You could have chosen to ignore the remark, but you didn't. I won't even analyze the with the microphone that happened on Friday. No, I haven't seen the video. If I see the video, I will never be able to un-see the video. Stefanik as Surrogate has not spoken out to distance herself from any of this behavior, which I find to be disqualifying of her candidacy. By the way, that expression, "surrogate" is her term, not mine. See her . The thought that lurks in the dark corners of my mind is that I have been Elise Stefanik's opponent on the 2024 ballot. Exactly how far does the list of enemies go? Will enemies of Trump surrogates also face retribution? Never mind. It's too late. I'm on the ballot. And I sure as heck can't go back. (Cue the chant: "We're not going back!) I'm going forward and continuing my call for Elise Stefanik to resign from office immediately. Stefanik has broken the oath she swore to protect and defend the U.S. Constitution from enemies foreign and domestic. Those enemies within, that the MAGAs talk about. Stefanik's campaign hub is not in New York State. The focus of her campaign activity is in Charlottesville, Virginia, at the Trump Winery, where she is in charge of "Women for Trump." That literally takes jobs out of the North Country. Jobs as political consultants. Jobs as campaign field operators. Jobs as political staff members. Jobs in political tech. Jobs as interns. None of those jobs are in the North Country in Elise Stefanik's campaign office. None of those jobs have been created for our North Country men and women, most of them in college or freshly out of college, to take. For that reason, Stefanik should immediately suspend her campaign for re-election. Locating the hub of your campaign activity outside of the state (much less outside of the district) is disqualifying. Each minute brings us closer to the close of polls on Election Night, November 5, 2024. I'm starting my race for the midterms on November 6, 2024. In the words of Alexy Navalny, "You are not allowed to give up." If we haven 't met yet, I am Paula Collins, the Democratic and Working Families Party Candidate for New York's 21st Congressional District. Your comments are invaluable to me. Please let me hear from you. Remember that you can always visit my website at www.paulacollinsforcongress.com or by sending me a text at 315-230-3920. | | | | | | | (C) 2024 Paula Collins 548 Market Street PMB 72296, San Francisco, CA 94104 ? ?

Team — I’m a little confused.

Last month this team came together and helped us put up an incredible day of fundraising. One of the best of the campaign.

It was awesome. It put some wind in my sails, honestly. Gave me hope.

But... since then we’ve had one of the worst fundraising stretches in months. No joke. People just aren’t chipping in, and that is a huge problem.

My team’s getting really worried. I’ve told them to take it day by day, but I promised I’d reach out and ask you — what happened?

Do people really think this race is all wrapped up? Cause I can tell you, personally, that it’s not. This state is going to be decided by less votes than it takes to fill a football stadium, and that is the truth. Arizona isn’t a blue state. Until very recently it was one of the reddest states in the country, and it could very easily go that way again.

But right now, we’re not pacing to our goals. We’re not pacing to stop Trump and Kari Lake from winning this November. And if we don’t pick things back up — FAST — we’re going to be in real trouble. Friend,

I couldn’t be more excited — brand new polling data is showing me up by a whopping 18 points with independents in Florida!
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96436551/510027092/849749119?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2487-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDc0NWZmOWMtOTQ5OS1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Cfdzn-kpJDSLFS6qbJm4U9kOslmB0QYwiiHJILNZeHw=)

name: Hillsdale College via First Look News
subject: Receive your exclusive copy today
body:
I’m thrilled to introduce an extraordinary opportunity for you...

This sponsored message from First Look News is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zjmhce3bdt8luuihpmuk8m3j53vk19p2uesb5u60_rp22sh2s8i6epj0cdh69o76cdh2bs)
---
---
| | Dear Friend,

I'm thrilled to introduce an extraordinary opportunity for you...

Perhaps you've wondered where the artwork accompanying the lectures in our free online courses comes from. We hear this especially for one of our most popular courses, "The Genesis Story."

The Book of Genesis has inspired some of Western Civilization's greatest artists to produce iconic works. You may be familiar with Michelangelo's "The Creation of Adam" and Rembrandt's "The Sacrifice of Issac."

I can still remember seeing "The Creation of Adam" right after I graduated from Hillsdale at the Sistine Chapel...

[](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zi01n5ruin7qm18vfiqasbqd0p47nl0d4n5dbe8o_rp22sh2s8i6epj0cdh69o76cdh2bs) **We 've compiled these paintings, along with many others featured in this course, into a brand-new coffee table book, "The Genesis Story: Course Companion." And I'd like you to receive a copy.**

With this exclusive book--available only from Hillsdale College--you can read the passages from the Book of Genesis that led Michelangelo, Rembrandt, Gustave Dore, and other masters to create these incredible works of art.

And with these works all in one place, you and your family can enjoy page after page of divinely inspired art.

**You can reserve your copy of "The Genesis Story: Course Companion," an exclusive hard-cover book from Hillsdale College, for a generous donation of $100 or more by clicking the secure link below: **

**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/genesis-story-course-companion-book](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2ze9kf5anoali669mngeovvvggormdk62v6hq3vr0_rp22sh2s8i6epj0cdh69o76cdh2bs)**

Thanks again for your continued support and generosity. I hope you'll enjoy this beautiful book.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01

Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

| | Dear Friend,

I'm thrilled to introduce an extraordinary opportunity for you...

Perhaps you've wondered where the artwork accompanying the lectures in our free online courses comes from. We hear this especially for one of our most popular courses, "The Genesis Story."

The Book of Genesis has inspired some of Western Civilization's greatest artists to produce iconic works. You may be familiar with Michelangelo's "The Creation of Adam" and Rembrandt's "The Sacrifice of Issac."

I can still remember seeing "The Creation of Adam" right after I graduated from Hillsdale at the Sistine Chapel...

[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zftnvu620bh6jv40rb9u6nghsg0pmcp0mfvkioh8_rp22sh2s8i6epj0cdj68or4clh2bs) **We 've compiled these paintings, along with many others featured in this course, into a brand-new coffee table book, "The Genesis Story: Course Companion." And I'd like you to receive a copy.**

With this exclusive book--available only from Hillsdale College--you can read the passages from the Book of Genesis that led Michelangelo, Rembrandt, Gustave Dore, and other masters to create these incredible works of art.

And with these works all in one place, you and your family can enjoy page after page of divinely inspired art.

**You can reserve your copy of "The Genesis Story: Course Companion," an exclusive hard-cover book from Hillsdale College, for a generous donation of $100 or more by clicking the secure link below: **

subject: My margin of defeat was razor-thin
body:
We missed flipping Connecticut’s 5th District by LESS THAN 1%.

| |
---
| | | | [](https://click.email.georgeloganforcongress.com/?qs=9a41d03309fbf52739250d4e689c1b834988b5e787a403f1d8572ba981710b49e2d23e03dd63099ab034cb1bc9b6a73b1c23f0856d3a059fdb2333f6dd350d9f)
---
_** 2,004 votes. **_

That's how close we came to defeating Squad member Jahana Hayes two years ago. We missed flipping Connecticut's 5th District by **LESS THAN 1%. **

| Debt functions like a credit card: maxing out one card, then opening another to continue spending. Each card adds interest, making it harder to pay off the principal. The U.S. national debt has followed this pattern for years.
[In](https://evan3879.wixsite.com/so/00PBmonuH/c?w=PraF2Gf9C6Wr5yiIGS3jnizIx5s0QC55b6XaplDx4pg.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cDovL3llYXJzLkluIiwiciI6IjgyMDc4ZDk3LTdlMzYtNGM2Ny1hZjUyLTRmZjBmMGZhNmNkYSIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjdjM2NiOWI2LTk5ZjQtNDU2ZC1iMWM3LTExZjQ4NTczMzYzMyJ9) 1976, the entire debt was around $630 billion—the same amount we paid in interest alone in 2023.
[In](https://evan3879.wixsite.com/so/00PBmonuH/c?w=S1fYxSCxv1ZY5qfdySWceWQn7eVAVg-8EsV95tNX_HE.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cDovLzIwMjMuSW4iLCJyIjoiODIwNzhkOTctN2UzNi00YzY3LWFmNTItNGZmMGYwZmE2Y2RhIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiN2MzY2I5YjYtOTlmNC00NTZkLWIxYzctMTFmNDg1NzMzNjMzIn0) 2024, interest payments are projected to reach $1.2 trillion.

body:
Is Mitch McConnell secretly stabbing conservative senators in the back this November?

| | |
---
|
---
Is Mitch McConnell secretly stabbing conservative senators in the back this November? That's the scoop, according to _The Hill: "**Cruz and Scott, both McConnell critics, get cold shoulder amid tough races."**_
---
|
---
---
|
---
Recent polls in Texas and Florida show incumbent Senators **Ted Cruz** and **Rick Scott** in neck-and-neck races against leftwing Democrat challengers with control of the Senate hanging in the balance. Yet, while McConnell’s money machine is pouring cash into some Senate races, it’s conspicuously ignoring these two key states. Everyone knows why. Ted Cruz and Rick Scott are conservative patriots, not leadership lapdogs. They fight for the American people and for the Constitution, which means they often challenge the Beltway Establishment. **[**Please don't sleep on these Senate races. Support Ted Cruz and Rick Scott with a split contribution today.**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/ruezDfMXH4Z4WyVzgFyvTQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRpCcNMP0Q7aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuc2VuYXRlY29uc2VydmF0aXZlcy5jb20vbzJmYTgvZD9jPXBxNW51enAxa2xXA3NwY0IKZxLQKydn-clfVFIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)** **_"Mitch McConnell runs the largest Republican super PAC in the country," said Senator Cruz. "It has $400 million, but that super PAC is used to reward the Republican Senators who obey him and to punish those who dare to stand up to him_."** So while Democrats pump millions into Texas and Florida to turn them blue, Washington Republicans are slow-walking their support — even as these races tighten. name: Hillsdale College via Updates For Great Americans
subject: Receive your exclusive copy of “The Genesis Story: Course Companion”
body:
I’m thrilled to introduce an extraordinary opportunity for you...

This sponsored message from Updates for Great Americans is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z112jrcgsrbbg6fsp5s1i4ob5drn0p0p523qe2no_rp22sh2s8i6epj0cdgm0or2c3h2bs)
---
---
| | Dear Friend,

I'm thrilled to introduce an extraordinary opportunity for you...

Perhaps you've wondered where the artwork accompanying the lectures in our free online courses comes from. We hear this especially for one of our most popular courses, "The Genesis Story."

The Book of Genesis has inspired some of Western Civilization's greatest artists to produce iconic works. You may be familiar with Michelangelo's "The Creation of Adam" and Rembrandt's "The Sacrifice of Issac."

I can still remember seeing "The Creation of Adam" right after I graduated from Hillsdale at the Sistine Chapel...

[](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zhkr5bgs57len746o09edmhdehjahnvtsaim034g_rp22sh2s8i6epj0cdgm0or2c3h2bs) **We 've compiled these paintings, along with many others featured in this course, into a brand-new coffee table book, "The Genesis Story: Course Companion." And I'd like you to receive a copy.**

With this exclusive book--available only from Hillsdale College--you can read the passages from the Book of Genesis that led Michelangelo, Rembrandt, Gustave Dore, and other masters to create these incredible works of art.

And with these works all in one place, you and your family can enjoy page after page of divinely inspired art.

**You can reserve your copy of "The Genesis Story: Course Companion," an exclusive hard-cover book from Hillsdale College, for a generous donation of $100 or more by clicking the secure link below: **

**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/genesis-story-course-companion-book](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z4clvja8e977abk55tenee7nicpb1he7jqela59o_rp22sh2s8i6epj0cdgm0or2c3h2bs)**

Thanks again for your continued support and generosity. I hope you'll enjoy this beautiful book.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College
---

| _You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T64064dd9-90e4-427a-b0c7-ccb867ba0245/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)._

| Peter – recently, we’ve been seeing headlines like this about our chances in the Senate: [](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf86c00a8-696b-4951-b579-86c517b91e26/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) And we’ll be honest: it’s making us anxious about Tuesday’s election results. It doesn’t help that pundits are saying “Democrats... are facing a terrible map.” We know what’s on the line: Democrats must defend multiple battleground states, including Montana, Ohio, Wisconsin, Nevada, and Pennsylvania. And polls are still tight as we head into the last 48 hours of this hectic election cycle. My love letter to Florida 💌
| | |
---
Friend, this message is a bit on the longer side, but I hope you'll take the time to read it. **[You see, in a lot of ways, this campaign is a love letter to Florida.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96437772/510028918/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2491-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMjA4YTk4MmYtY2Q5OS1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=ma5Wfz86G-lLBKPWCX7mzuwTQwU36zh_rzU9wnR7Zyc=)**
I can still remember the first time that I came to Florida. I was working on my master's degree and had just gotten the news that my beloved father had been killed by a criminal with a gun in Ecuador, where I was born. As I grappled with my grief, I found myself missing Ecuador more than I had in years. I missed its warmth, lush greenery, and close-knit communities that I grew up with. My older sister, Monica, knew our family was struggling, so she convinced me to visit her in Miami, where she had recently moved.
When I stepped outside of the airport, it was like stepping into another world. **It was warm, wonderfully humid, bustling with lively, diverse communities, lush, and all so, so beautifully green.** We spent the next few days visiting all of Monica's favorite places in her new city — the spots with the most beautiful views and the best cafes to get a _cafecito_. The people we met were even warmer than the weather. Everyone was welcoming, friendly, and proud to call this state their home.
I boarded my plane back to my home with a heavy heart but a new resolve. **As soon as I was able, I sold my car and moved across the country to live in a one room apartment in America.**(My mom, always my closest confidant, wasn't far behind.)
Since moving here all those years ago, I've had the privilege to build a beautiful life in the Sunshine State. **I fell in love here, found the community I had longed for, raised a family of my own, and dedicated my career to serving this state.** I've helped protect the Everglades, expanded access to health care, worked for Florida International University, and became the first South American immigrant elected to Congress, right here in Florida.
I've spent my life serving this state and getting to know the communities who call it home. But my opponent, Rick Scott, has spent his career scamming Floridians, lying to voters, and making himself richer. **He wants you to think that Florida families agree with his extreme, hateful agenda._But I can promise you, friend, that couldn't be further from the truth._**
Listen, my campaign is deeply personal because of my love for this state — and more importantly, because of what it will mean for my fellow Floridians. Rick Scott wants to sow division and undo decades of meaningful progress. He wants to destroy reproductive rights, gun safety laws, and vital public services, like Medicare and Social Security, that support millions of his constituents, including my own mother.

Florida is ready for a change — I hear it from voters every day as I travel around all 67 counties. I know that Floridians will choose unity, progress, and kindness over Rick Scott's extremist agenda.

But the truth is, we're up against a mega-millionaire who spent $64 million of his personal fortune to buy this seat last time. If we're going to break through Rick Scott's lies, build unstoppable grassroots momentum, and win this critical race, I'll need your help.

**[Please, will you donate $5 (or whatever you can spare today) to help me defeat Rick Scott and give our home the leadership that we deserve? This _will_ be the year that we flip Florida blue, but only if grassroots activists like _you_ believe in my campaign.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96437773/510028919/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2491-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMjA4YTk4MmYtY2Q5OS1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=ma5Wfz86G-lLBKPWCX7mzuwTQwU36zh_rzU9wnR7Zyc=)**

subject: We can shape our nation's future
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWCo6rBWNi

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWCo6rBWNi

Dear friend,

Politics often leaves a bitter taste in our mouths. It's no wonder so many of us approach it with disdain. The endless mudslinging, pandering to special interest groups, and policies shaped by poll numbers rather than deeply held
convictions make politics seem like a world Christians should avoid.

Yet, as Christians, we can't ignore the rapid unraveling of our culture or remain passive in the face of the evil we see around us. The Bible tells us that our citizenship is in heaven (Philippians 3:20) and that we are aliens and strangers
in this world (1 Peter 2:11). But does that mean we should leave governing to unbelievers? Should we invest our time in influencing what seems transitory at best?

The answer is simple: Jesus commanded us to be the salt and light of the world (Matthew 5:13-14). As Christians, we are called to preserve the spiritual and moral fabric of society wherever God has placed us. And that includes influencing
every aspect of our culture-entertainment, business, education, and yes, even government.

As the upcoming election approaches, how should we allow the Bible to guide our decisions? In my new 44-page booklet, How a Christian Should Vote, I offer a biblical framework for assessing candidates, their faith,
policies, and constitutional views. This practical resource will help you view the election from a biblical perspective, equipping you to make informed decisions.

There are 4 main questions that a Christian should be asking themselves before casting a vote:

Is the candidate a Christian?
Do the candidate's policies align with the Bible?
What is the candidate's view of Israel?
Will the candidate get things done?

You can receive a free copy of How a Christian Should Vote in time for the elections by clicking here: https://ptv.org/nna/how-a-christian-should-vote-by-dr-robert-jeffress-2024/

Together, we can determine the direction of our country by voting for leaders who will embrace principles that bring God's favor upon our nation.

In Christ,

Dr. Robert Jeffress

P.S. Jesus commanded us to be salt and light in this world. Through the ministry of Pathway to Victory, we are using the most effective media available-television, radio, print, and digital-to spread the Gospel!
Request your free copy of How a Christian Should Vote today and join us in making a difference.

# Lost Your Ballot? Still Fed Up Enough to Vote?
---
| You can show up at any vote center in your county and request a new ballot to vote.
You can also register while you're there, if you're not registered to vote.
Don't know how to vote? Stuff on the ballot too confusing? You don't have to vote on everything - you can leave things blank.

Peter's recommendations:
* Vote for anything but "Democratic"

We have a Democrat supermajority in our state and they've gone crazy with many of their anti-family, anti-small business, anti-religion, anti-law & order policies. The Federal government has suffered greatly under Democrat leadership. It's time for change!

* State Ballot Propositions

Just say NO to any more spending. The only YES I'd recommend is Prop 36, which partially repeals the original Prop 47 that gave criminals the green light to steal up to $950 without felony charges.

* Vote for Peter Hernandez for Congressional District 18!

# [Leonardo da Vinci did most of his writing backward.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=smditr&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [Arts & Culture](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=smditr&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=smditr&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| F amed Renaissance polymath Leonardo da Vinci left behind thousands of pages of notes and diagrams from his many pursuits in math, anatomy, botany, science, engineering, and art — he created more than 200 illustrations with notes on flight alone. Leonardo had groundbreaking ideas on everything from human anatomy to bridge design, and even the writing itself is impressive: Most of it is written from right to left, in a [mirror image](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=smditr&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) of ordinary European script. He only wrote left to right when someone else needed to read it. He also used his own form of shorthand.
---
Leonardo never directly explained why he wrote this way, but there are a few prevailing theories. It may have been simply practical: The artist was most likely left-handed, and writing left to right could get messy using a pen and ink. He also may have been trying to keep his ideas secret from potential copycats, or even trying to hide his work from the Roman Catholic Church. While Leonardo’s artwork is rich with religious symbolism, he was also a skeptic, and some of his ideas would have been at odds with the teachings of the church. After Leonardo’s death, his loose-leaf notes went to his student Francesco Melzi, an Italian painter. They were bound into several volumes, mirror writing and all, and soon began circulating among European elites as collector’s items. They are still kept in museums and private collections today.

## There’s a reason kids write letters backward.
A hallmark of little-kid handwriting is the occasional backward letter, such as “ANDY” written with a backward “N” on Woody’s boot in the _Toy Story_ franchise. It’s not that young children don’t understand or recognize letters, or even that they’re getting the shapes wrong — it’s that their spatial perception is different. Human brains have something called “mirror generalization,” which is how we perceive items as the same in mirror image. We can still recognize major landmarks if they’re flipped horizontally, or identify an animal whether it’s facing left or right. For most things we see every day — oranges, chairs, cats — a mirror image doesn’t change their meaning. The way the brain develops, letters work the same way for kids under 7 years old, so a backward “N” is still an “N.”

clean_body: Famed Renaissance polymath Leonardo da Vinci left behind thousands of pages of notes and diagrams from his many pursuits in math, anatomy, botany, science, engineering, and art — he created more than 200 illustrations with notes on flight alone. | F amed Renaissance polymath Leonardo da Vinci left behind thousands of pages of notes and diagrams from his many pursuits in math, anatomy, botany, science, engineering, and art — he created more than 200 illustrations with notes on flight alone. Leonardo had groundbreaking ideas on everything from human anatomy to bridge design, and even the writing itself is impressive: Most of it is written from right to left, in a of ordinary European script. He only wrote left to right when someone else needed to read it. He also used his own form of shorthand. Leonardo never directly explained why he wrote this way, but there are a few prevailing theories. It may have been simply practical: The artist was most likely left-handed, and writing left to right could get messy using a pen and ink. He also may have been trying to keep his ideas secret from potential copycats, or even trying to hide his work from the Roman Catholic Church. While Leonardo’s artwork is rich with religious symbolism, he was also a skeptic, and some of his ideas would have been at odds with the teachings of the church. After Leonardo’s death, his loose-leaf notes went to his student Francesco Melzi, an Italian painter. They were bound into several volumes, mirror writing and all, and soon began circulating among European elites as collector’s items. They are still kept in museums and private collections today. | Thank you for supporting our advertisers! | By the Numbers | | Price Bill Gates paid for Leonardo’s Codex Leicester in 1994 $30.8 million | | Planned height (in feet) of a horse statue Leonardo never got to finish 24 | Planned height (in feet) of a horse statue Leonardo never got to finish 24 | | Approximate number of authenticated surviving paintings by Leonardo 15 | | Estimated percentage of human beings who are left-handed 10% | Estimated percentage of human beings who are left-handed 10% | | | Did you know? ---|---|--- There’s a reason kids write letters backward. A hallmark of little-kid handwriting is the occasional backward letter, such as “ANDY” written with a backward “N” on Woody’s boot in the Toy Story franchise. It’s not that young children don’t understand or recognize letters, or even that they’re getting the shapes wrong — it’s that their spatial perception is different. Human brains have something called “mirror generalization,” which is how we perceive items as the same in mirror image. We can still recognize major landmarks if they’re flipped horizontally, or identify an animal whether it’s facing left or right. For most things we see every day — oranges, chairs, cats — a mirror image doesn’t change their meaning. Democrats need to win majorities in the state house and state senate to prevent Republicans from engaging in mid-cycle partisan gerrymandering. In Michigan, Republicans are trying to take back the state house and end the Democratic trifecta we helped win in 2022. If they do, they could attempt to roll back progress on fair maps by targeting the state’s independent redistricting commission. In Minnesota, the Democrats hold a trifecta which helped enact Gov. Tim Walz’s bold agenda. Republicans only need to flip five seats to gain control of the state house and block all the amazing progress we’ve seen there this year. Pennsylvania is currently the only state in the country with a divided legislature (where Democrats hold one legislative chamber and Republicans hold the other), after Democrats flipped the state house in 2022. If we flip the state senate AND hold the state house , another Democratic trifecta will give us a route to redistricting reform. The work is not over. ## Zelenskyy: Let Us Strike North Koreans
President Volodymyr Zelenskyy urged Western nations on Saturday to permit his forces to target the 8,000 [North Korean troops inside Russia](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00DGuozAQgOHTmM7IM3ZwKFxsQ5dtt0QODGE2Dkb2JIg9_eq9_l3g16_vz228RU68PX7HFwVZ8ogGnQbQxo5z5HSOrpnDQoRkGwrgrels5zrbrAF99B2Q66f5gr63EeiOl3tvvb9Y6KDh8FUDMBYQeuNairFfZucmMMsVrlE5QzNLLu3fzJustKQzf6i0U341Kawie1X2l8JB4XAcR7vnxMJTbumtcIhFeEqkcPhHibb6PE8tWR9URScS_a56ZdFbLrLqZy4UNy0l571q3nR518pR4dCUMO8Hp8S188qZxyty-l6Qn0g-Af8HAAD___IpZMg) preparing to attack Ukraine. "_America is watching, Britain is watching, Germany is watching_ ," Zelenskyy said. "_Everyone is just waiting for the North Korean military to start attacking Ukrainians_." Zelenskyy wants to use Western-made long-range weapons to attack the North Korean troops, but U.S. defense officials have pointed out that Ukraine is already using its own [long-range drones](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvwyAQRn-NvRFxcDYwMHTJlq4drSucYxpiLEwS5d9X7t7x0yc9Pb2vy3ShlNN6_aQ7-zaXSUmFAkBIPUVK-T1hH_3MrFj37MFoOeoRR90vPhggJAZHDo20gMEZZexoY4g8EPfJHzQAqUGBk3hiIjdHxABytmCpQ8kxtVJPPyWtbeE5v8uT6ymUe5_90tq2d_qjU-dOnWlb-bUf1zFqSyFzp871se-JxONWKa0sXlTFWmpbxK1UJtFqKdsuHCgeeECKGoz8jsYMVqIcwjg7I8H21cftlXJO-2g6lNc7pfyn0f7L8vTqNwAA__8t9mMw) to hit targets in Russia.
## Detective Convicted in Breonna Taylor Case
Former Kentucky police detective Brett Hankison was convicted late Friday on federal charges that he used excessive force by firing into [Breonna Taylor's home](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO6yAQRb_G7ohgwGAXFK9Jl9duaU3MEM-GQIRJIv_9yttveXWlo6PzdZkvyInz7T8-yLdYZpBghFJC6jkgp302ffCRCEj35JXT0mprrO5XP1lJYQQbtBxlNM5FJ0kNGhwiyDj17A-aUlIrUJM0J0KcYjBmUTKOasTOSArcSj19F85tpZj28qZ6WsqjT35t7bl1-l8H5w7O-Mz02Y7rGLXxkqiD87VSyRlFwz2VKq6VWhMr5jtvJYs75fZa7rtI5cXbm1MioWlZMBo1TBBH5YCsJT0MbhgsjtOV-urD88Mp8WZdZ-TtgZx-ldpfid4efgIAAP__Dd5oNA) in a botched 2020 drug raid. Taylor, 26, was fatally shot, but not by Hankison, and he was not charged with her death. The [ten shots Hankison fired](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kD1vgzAQQH8NbEb22eFj8NAlW7p2RAc-wjXGF4Ebi39fpXv3p_ek93Ubb8iR0_0TN_J5kRE0OGWM0nYMyPEcXR38QgRka_Kms7q1rWttvXprAPoJCajvQAeYwhLQBZqg7dzF6Zr922aMtgbMoF1DiMMSnJuNXnrTY-U0Bc6yN9_CKa-0xFNetDezbHX0a87Po7IfFVwruJZSmkTlKESPN1DBddpJUkKV8Yyyq03ySrs6noSPQ8lPVscqkjnd1SzpxXNmScoM3aAvrt59eBaOkY-2q5y-b8jxL5z_G_Hy8BsAAP__u-thqw) into Taylor's glass door and windows did not hit anyone, but some entered a next-door neighbor's apartment. He was acquitted of violating the neighbor's civil rights. Police were seeking evidence in [a narcotics investigation](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LGOszAQBOCngc5o13ZMKFz8DV3-9kpk7AX2zrEj4wTx9qecrr3uk0YajebjNt0cR07rf3cnW5c8SZBaIApQU3Acz0m3wS5EklRLFnsFRhltVLtZhZ4MAAYiCbPHyww6GNN7uQwXHLBl-25DBIUSB9AdOTcsQWuPsFzx6hoNFLjm0n1mTnWjJZ75RaXz-d5Gu9X62Bv1r5FjI8fjOLo0-0TH_s4bOb7ZyPG5i1_NhWoVm0tfvOck5kI5JSeqO2MuYn1yrKfw_OIoCq9b3UXxyWF_hYtpiw2Pg2Pk3fSNhvXuOP4MqX8d87LyOwAA__-UMmax) that targeted her ex-boyfriend, who lived at a different address. Taylor's boyfriend fired a shot toward the front door because he thought intruders were breaking in, U.S. Attorney Merrick Garland has said. Two officers immediately fired 22 shots into the apartment, one of which killed Taylor.

| Flying together with our sponsor [](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0zz1uwyAUAODTwBaLv-J4YMhQhkrOUlXpZmF44FdhYxHkKLev2j0X-KTvNk6jw4xburoVTItlEkyoE-cnJqfgMD8nRYOJAAIkBcN7ybTUSku6mF6DmPsZlAQR_JvjvdczDBAHqZ1ngaL50zhnkgs-MNWBc0MMSnnO4pmfHVEMArZSu5-CW1sg5mc5oHa-rDSbpbX9TuSFCEuETXjglrpHqTn4snmoW1dqIsLuLgER1n5db-P758f3xdJqwv7AnPGue6JYWh3mf7W9Wh5G_AYAAP__-LlUYg) Somalia is facing a devastating combination of natural disasters, global conflicts, widespread poverty, and disease outbreaks. East Africa has just endured its worst drought in 40 years, leaving tens of millions without access to clean water, wiping out millions of livestock, and destroying crops. With domestic food production crippled, Somalia has relied heavily on imports--90% of its wheat coming from Russia and Ukraine--until those shipments stopped. Now, two in five children in Somalia suffer from acute malnutrition, and cholera is spreading in some regions. The food crisis, compounded by global humanitarian aid being redirected to Europe and the Middle East, has created a perfect storm, leading to a sharp rise in child malnutrition. body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2179%2E135344%2EFQ4VmT)

[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-nov24.k4yPYt&refcode=em241103-1-900&t=2&akid=2179%2E135344%2EFQ4VmT)
---
Friends -
I’ve been voting for over 40 years, and my first vote was for Ronald Reagan. And in 2022, I did something I had never done before: campaigned on behalf of a Democrat, for Elissa Slotkin in her congressional campaign.
I endorsed Elissa in her race in 2022 because I had seen her work in the House, and I know that she is someone who is laser-focused on doing the right thing for the people she represents and will put service to our country over service to herself, every time.
The choice to me was clear then, and it’s even clearer now. **That’s why I am supporting Elissa Slotkin in her campaign for United States Senate in Michigan.**
The stakes in this election are unlike anything we've ever faced before. But the future of our democracy is on the line, and this is not about policy differences. It’s about doing what’s right for our country.

Peter —
When I was in Iraq, in urban combat, we had a special knock we’d use when we were surrounded by insurgents.
The comfort in that knock was knowing that while danger was all around you, the person on the other side of the door was friendly — someone you could depend on.
I’ve never been afraid to ask for help when I needed it. And right now, I’m knocking. I’m coming to you for help, Peter.
Kari Lake is on the offense. With just a few days until voting ends, she has a resource advantage over us. She’s got more money to spend, and she is funneling all of it into a massive surge. She’s outspending us on television in one of the most important regions of the state. **But I refuse to let her win.**
I did not swear an oath to support and defend the Constitution to lose against someone who has spread lies and disinformation about our elections. **[If you’re with me, donate $10.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/82957?refcode=em20241103-8593&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=8593%2E614464%2EjBZ8Eo)**
I did not lose some of my best friends in combat to cede the democracy they fought for to Kari Lake. This election is bigger than just who controls the House, the Senate, or the White House. It is about ensuring our democracy survives for our kids and our grandkids. **[If you’re with me, donate $10.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/82957?refcode=em20241103-8593&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=8593%2E614464%2EjBZ8Eo)**

|
---

Fellow American,

You may already know who I am from my basketball career. Or, maybe you're just hearing about me for the first time through my Senate Campaign. Either way, I wanted to formally introduce myself and share my story. [**_Afterward, I 'm going to ask you to send a small contribution to my campaign as I continue to fight to Flip the Senate Red._**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=54b1446a96094251b3adbeb508055f66&_e=t-Hu8YG5IocK32pBHR5DG_KHkCo6pBj4n-nwixKH2-o0I0hy9NOylWeYrd9998Z_iY78TsvXTGZ7vO_LIWAOj0lANikbjZAPrtkIfxb6a8hJg5KSo8GHBzL5J5aWL1qWqh03Oti1FIBuFIO7pI-ORBMptX0G1KtDZZwQPpjThcMR_jw5NQPqjvNvRf6z4xb5n9zCoMk_WlUuY1PQCLS7lOVblDgNdjrJiZ_3pBE3YIjafATECaFYWFoe5r6SrxFzhhMxRA0_eYXtQYAiTY8t4Vov-JcfKS5sTcCGh_ZuifkEjMGYYaXudqDh0uIN7cy-3EfZxUpHEKAr-HCP0Yx-Gg%3D%3D)

I was born and raised in the Twin Cities in Minnesota, mainly in the Rondo Community of St. Paul. At the age of five, I started playing sports, and at nine years old, I was already playing basketball on the Northside of Minneapolis. My mother was a single mother who worked tirelessly to give me a better life. I went to school in Rondo and began to excel at basketball. By 10th grade, I was ranked as a top 20 player in the country. I remember dreaming of reaching the NBA one day- a dream shared by millions of kids.

[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=54b1446a96094251b3adbeb508055f66&_e=t-Hu8YG5IocK32pBHR5DG_KHkCo6pBj4n-nwixKH2-o0I0hy9NOylWeYrd9998Z_iY78TsvXTGZ7vO_LIWAOj0lANikbjZAPrtkIfxb6a8hJg5KSo8GHBzL5J5aWL1qWqh03Oti1FIBuFIO7pI-ORBMptX0G1KtDZZwQPpjThcMR_jw5NQPqjvNvRf6z4xb5zVpBSjcoQTFThS1w0ehJImK2_-2pvt2JiFR-LyvYtkpo9kEPDX9ojLN85UFE2rSTDC80dz0HdRVRVJpEXmg8OD5Q3ZyB4_bLLyMZ7YivcmnMo7tdLmtmquwupYmiQCe0dn5BodqpCfxQpV77xo8_oA%3D%3D)
I accepted a scholarship at the University of Minnesota, but shortly after transferred to Iowa State. There, I won multiple basketball awards while working hard in class and being named on the Dean's List for academics.

[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=54b1446a96094251b3adbeb508055f66&_e=t-Hu8YG5IocK32pBHR5DG_KHkCo6pBj4n-nwixKH2-o0I0hy9NOylWeYrd9998Z_iY78TsvXTGZ7vO_LIWAOj0lANikbjZAPrtkIfxb6a8hJg5KSo8GHBzL5J5aWL1qWqh03Oti1FIBuFIO7pI-ORBMptX0G1KtDZZwQPpjThcMR_jw5NQPqjvNvRf6z4xb5dNn1WsGRQN55mqEe9o4MHvIQIPlPe_5yu58fUb5wnEldtaPj4iS8dMWSfLQI4B7nhhQvlgSETg8SmaORLm7CQ6TxPc63igq9zcVaVMHFTenYaglkJ73zREEDzVwmTrEO8RmNkiS4iPCzC8ytnIjOrQ%3D%3D)
Finally, my dream came true. I was selected in the first round of the 2012 NBA Draft, going to the Houston Rockets. While playing at the highest level of basketball competition in the world, I began to voice concerns about the NBA's Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA), specifically regarding mental health policy, which at the time did not exist.

Eventually, my concerns became a dispute between the NBA and myself, until I demanded that the NBA spearhead the mental health conversation through policy. This led to the end of my NBA career, but my work led to the NBA implementing policies to support players' mental health.

[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=54b1446a96094251b3adbeb508055f66&_e=t-Hu8YG5IocK32pBHR5DG_KHkCo6pBj4n-nwixKH2-o0I0hy9NOylWeYrd9998Z_iY78TsvXTGZ7vO_LIWAOj0lANikbjZAPrtkIfxb6a8hJg5KSo8GHBzL5J5aWL1qWqh03Oti1FIBuFIO7pI-ORBMptX0G1KtDZZwQPpjThcMR_jw5NQPqjvNvRf6z4xb5SF-L5axObvMU9y-5UNSN_Wo5hsodu5iFJ6naG1XJw7quk_-1WwbsFXojriYpl2QDVb2QwPkjSM8jOKwOu2uLZHZvFtnV_CT1A146yBwOdk-T6vvtKDvbvbCNjA47DNqXYnBULMJeR3huxbM5Uauscg%3D%3D)
I gave up my dream of playing in the NBA to stand up for something I fully believe in. That experience gave me the courage to run for Congress in 2022 and for Senate in 2024. More on that later.

After leaving the NBA, I took my talents to Canada, playing professional basketball and winning two championships. Then, I joined the BIG 3 Basketball Tournament, a professional 3 on 3 league; I still play today.

[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=54b1446a96094251b3adbeb508055f66&_e=t-Hu8YG5IocK32pBHR5DG_KHkCo6pBj4n-nwixKH2-o0I0hy9NOylWeYrd9998Z_iY78TsvXTGZ7vO_LIWAOj0lANikbjZAPrtkIfxb6a8hJg5KSo8GHBzL5J5aWL1qWqh03Oti1FIBuFIO7pI-ORBMptX0G1KtDZZwQPpjThcMR_jw5NQPqjvNvRf6z4xb524C_W3Qub0oEijsRbYSAavgLmmmVwDsMsGBBXyH0TtkWZ0bEwKPNfhH4Q5ZnEKb-tfMIcuLia6CGzwNWsrt4ASaju2wb7ujExJY70w7bcCEU-OQxI9kcy-ilPZw9AWrX0v-TQU27_I17XCmhPy3jzg%3D%3D)
It was at this point that I became increasingly vocal about standing up for the core principles that I believe in. I've continued to be outspoken on taboo subjects, like freeing the Uyghurs, the Federal Reserve, Julian Assange, Edward Snowden, Muammar Gaddafi, and many others. **I 'm not afraid to speak up and say the silent part out loud. I will never just shut up and dribble.**

In 2022, I decided to run for Congress against Radical Leftist and Squad Founder, Ilhan Omar. The Deep State Democrats lined her pocket with millions of dollars to beat me, and I came up short.

[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=54b1446a96094251b3adbeb508055f66&_e=t-Hu8YG5IocK32pBHR5DG_KHkCo6pBj4n-nwixKH2-o0I0hy9NOylWeYrd9998Z_iY78TsvXTGZ7vO_LIWAOj0lANikbjZAPrtkIfxb6a8hJg5KSo8GHBzL5J5aWL1qWqh03Oti1FIBuFIO7pI-ORBMptX0G1KtDZZwQPpjThcMR_jw5NQPqjvNvRf6z4xb5VTrMpLFuwNKHdIdMwPX4iMrPNSAWan_5g-sETDQFeKGqKwOubTHRD0cnJHE1jXKrraawAnx1WaSgur3w8rU5GkKE92XoilxJC0K4HOcs06dY1n1koszps6fqBAXNpvRMaVV8EXScnUefMEAOT0Pm2g%3D%3D)
Now, I'm running for United States Senate to defeat lifelong politician Amy Klobuchar. She represents the Radical Left's Elites who would rather see America become the next Communist China or Soviet Russia. The Industrial Media Complex will continue to spread false narratives claiming that I have little chance of winning. But they continue to ignore my strong grassroots movement with the American People, who are sick and tired of being overstepped, ignored, and told to accept the policies that our Liberal Leaders force down our throats.

We CAN win, but it's going to take the help of a huge grassroots movement. That's why I'm emailing you today, friend. We have a chance to make history by electing the youngest US Senator and the first one born in the 1990s.

[**I am humbly asking you to send my campaign a small donation of whatever you can afford. Whether it 's $5, $15, or $25, every single donation makes a difference.**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=54b1446a96094251b3adbeb508055f66&_e=t-Hu8YG5IocK32pBHR5DG_KHkCo6pBj4n-nwixKH2-o0I0hy9NOylWeYrd9998Z_iY78TsvXTGZ7vO_LIWAOj0lANikbjZAPrtkIfxb6a8hJg5KSo8GHBzL5J5aWL1qWqh03Oti1FIBuFIO7pI-ORBMptX0G1KtDZZwQPpjThcMR_jw5NQPqjvNvRf6z4xb5gI2I6_KtZ0KMCXxRFpbXjixdj_7O7SvaHBIfwsC2rsnQxTLtvNipodiD98e-WS2py9RfBcsRsPndj-WUnaqbYiM3ZCDH00NQuYvaY4Gau1ifKq4XiZFmQ-TVPgrcIFZc_mtMC9NSaXMiBIS1CLnwYA%3D%3D)

I'm looking forward to getting to know you better, and I hope you'll join my team.

Talk Soon,

Royce White

| PAID FOR BY ROYCE WHITE FOR SENATE
P.O. Box 5473 Hopkins, MN 55343

subject: The Middle Class Needs Donald Trump
body:
There can be no compromise or middle ground regarding America’s middle class. | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/3b96a1286451/when-we-vote-we-win-14760617?e=8763c56857)

[](https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=16f81fa773&e=8763c56857)

|
# The Middle Class Needs Donald Trump
---
|
# By Dominic Rapini, American Businessman
# and Political Commentator
---
|
---
|
**There can be no compromise or middle ground regarding America’s middle class.** When it comes to America’s middle class, there can be no middle ground and no compromise. The strength of our economy rests on their shoulders, yet for four years, we’ve watched the Biden-Harris administration wage an all-out assault on the American Dream. Crushing inflation has left families, fixed-income seniors, and aspiring members of Generation X struggling to find financial footing. Americans need a champion who genuinely cares about their prosperity. Donald Trump will champion the middle class with the same common-sense and innovative economic policies that once empowered this nation. When Trump’s policies return, so will growth and prosperity, and then all Americans will win. **One of Trump’s most potent economic tools is tariffs** The middle class is America's backbone. It is our workforce, our small business owners, and our consumers. This group's health is essential to our nation's health, and Donald Trump understands this better than any American or global leader. Trump is a generational figure, the best hope for restoring the American Dream for everyone, regardless of race, gender, or political beliefs. One of Trump’s most potent economic tools is tariffs. Often misunderstood, tariffs are a crucial weapon in his economic arsenal to protect American workers. Trump has used them strategically to level the playing field against foreign competition, ensuring American businesses remain in the United States. The result? Job growth, rising wages, and opportunities for the middle class. Under Biden, foreign governments continue to subsidize their labor and flood our market with cheap imports, suppressing American wages. Trump stood firm against these tactics, so the middle class thrived under his leadership. **Help Companies invest and create jobs** During Trump’s presidency, particularly before the pandemic, we saw historically low unemployment, high workforce participation, and a narrowing pay equity gap. These weren’t empty statistics; they were real gains felt by everyday Americans—Hispanic Americans, Blacks, women, people of all races and backgrounds. Trump’s corporate tax cuts, though perhaps not immediately obvious to the average American, played a crucial role in this middle-class prosperity. When corporations have more money, they reinvest in their workers, ensuring wages remain competitive and jobs stay right here in the United States.
---
|
**Energy Independence means Economic Growth** Trump’s push for energy independence was another cornerstone of his agenda. By deregulating the fossil fuel industry, allowing drilling on federal lands, and withdrawing from the Paris Climate Agreement, he made the U.S. energy independent for the first time in decades. This led to lower energy prices, more jobs, and increased national security. Contrast that with Biden’s policies: the closure of American pipelines, higher energy costs, and a reliance on overseas energy production. While the long-term potential of green energy is essential, the middle class is paying the immediate price through skyrocketing utility bills and increased heating costs. While blunt, Trump’s “drill, baby, drill” approach shows a clear understanding of how energy independence benefits the middle class by lowering costs and enhancing prosperity. **Small Businesses are our Nation’s Economic** Trump was also a steadfast supporter of small businesses. Through the Paycheck Protection Program (PPP), he provided critical relief during the pandemic, helping businesses survive and retain employees during an unprecedented economic crisis. By cutting red tape and offering real support to small business owners, Trump ensured that America's backbone—the middle class—had the resources to recover and thrive. Trump will introduce fresh, innovative policies targeting the middle class in his next administration. Imagine the immediate impact of eliminating taxes on hard-earned tips, abolishing taxes on car loans, and ending the ludicrous tax on Social Security income. These bold ideas would have dramatic benefits for hardworking and retired middle-class Americans. **Please Stop Helping Us** Meanwhile, Vice President Harris continues her dangerous rhetoric about increasing taxes on corporations and repealing Trump’s tax cuts, which benefited 85% of Americans. Her blatant pandering to the Black community through “forgivable loans” and empty promises reveals her desperation. The Black middle class has awakened, and they’ve had enough. As they will tell Harris themselves: “Stop helping us.” Black men don’t want handouts; they want the government to step aside so they can succeed on their terms. That is the American Dream. **America needs a Builder** At his core, Donald Trump is a builder. Whether constructing a golf course or a skyscraper, he knows how to maximize his available tools. He brought that same mindset to the American economy during his presidency, prioritizing middle-class prosperity. His policies aimed to reduce costs, expand opportunities, and ensure every American could experience the wealth and success they deserve. _**Now more than ever, America needs Donald Trump. We need his economic toolkit and unshakeable commitment to putting the American worker first. It’s time to put America first again.**_
