When corporations have more money, they reinvest in their workers, ensuring wages remain competitive and jobs stay right here in the United States. | Energy Independence means Economic Growth Trump’s push for energy independence was another cornerstone of his agenda. By deregulating the fossil fuel industry, allowing drilling on federal lands, and withdrawing from the Paris Climate Agreement, he made the U.S. energy independent for the first time in decades. This led to lower energy prices, more jobs, and increased national security. Contrast that with Biden’s policies: the closure of American pipelines, higher energy costs, and a reliance on overseas energy production. While the long-term potential of green energy is essential, the middle class is paying the immediate price through skyrocketing utility bills and increased heating costs. While blunt, Trump’s “drill, baby, drill” approach shows a clear understanding of how energy independence benefits the middle class by lowering costs and enhancing prosperity. Small Businesses are our Nation’s Economic Trump was also a steadfast supporter of small businesses. Through the Paycheck Protection Program (PPP), he provided critical relief during the pandemic, helping businesses survive and retain employees during an unprecedented economic crisis. By cutting red tape and offering real support to small business owners, Trump ensured that America's backbone—the middle class—had the resources to recover and thrive. Trump will introduce fresh, innovative policies targeting the middle class in his next administration. Imagine the immediate impact of eliminating taxes on hard-earned tips, abolishing taxes on car loans, and ending the ludicrous tax on Social Security income. These bold ideas would have dramatic benefits for hardworking and retired middle-class Americans. Please Stop Helping Us Meanwhile, Vice President Harris continues her dangerous rhetoric about increasing taxes on corporations and repealing Trump’s tax cuts, which benefited 85% of Americans. Her blatant pandering to the Black community through “forgivable loans” and empty promises reveals her desperation. The Black middle class has awakened, and they’ve had enough. As they will tell Harris themselves: “Stop helping us.” Black men don’t want handouts; they want the government to step aside so they can succeed on their terms. That is the American Dream. America needs a Builder At his core, Donald Trump is a builder. Whether constructing a golf course or a skyscraper, he knows how to maximize his available tools. He brought that same mindset to the American economy during his presidency, prioritizing middle-class prosperity. His policies aimed to reduce costs, expand opportunities, and ensure every American could experience the wealth and success they deserve. Now more than ever, America needs Donald Trump. We need his economic toolkit and unshakeable commitment to putting the American worker first. It’s time to put America first again. | | | | | | | | | Copyright (C) 2024 Dominic For CT. **Riley Gaines** has been a champion against this movement for transgendered women in women's athletics and was one of **16 female athletes that sued NCAA over gender identity policies. In addition, there are many women who have lost their scholarships to transgendered women,**

subject: Civil discourse needs resuscitation
body:
News + editorial to start your week | Broad + Liberty Weekly Reads | | | |
---
| | | Good morning and welcome to _Broad + Liberty_ 's Weekly Reads.

[Subscribe to our daily email list](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=b0dfc49969&e=b7b3eddce2) and get the best of _Broad + Liberty_ delivered straight to your inbox.
---
|
---
|
### **1.[Trump didn’t start the fire. He’s the fireman.](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=7af637de3a&e=b7b3eddce2)**
_By Guy Ciarrocchi_
Of all the attacks on Trump, the line of attack that is most bizarre, backward, and most disconnected from reality is that he’s the cause of America’s tension, chaos and division.

That’s like blaming the firemen rushing to the scene — with their alarms blaring — for making too much noise or causing the fire. Whether or not the siren is too loud, or whether it offends you or brings you comfort knowing help is on the way, the firemen are the response.

Trump is the fireman. The fireman that much of the nation has been waiting for. To millions of Americans, too many of the fires are still burning. Biden and Harris allowed or encouraged some arsonists, poured gasoline on the fires, and now sit powerless watching our enemies set fires around the world.

**Why It Matters**. It wasn’t Trump that allowed millions of illegal immigrants into our nation. It wasn’t he who didn’t vet them, or who handed them a slip of paper asking them to report to a court hearing date two years from when they crossed over. He didn’t create “sanctuary cities” or refuse to deport known criminals — even after they were arrested. He didn’t choose to deposit tens of thousands of them in small towns, allow known felons and terrorists into our nation, give them free housing, cell phones, cash and medical care — or, suggested that taxpayers pay for their gender transition surgery.

It wasn’t Trump that passed legislation that helped put American manufacturers out of business — that encouraged manufacturing to move to Mexico and China.

Trump is the response. And seeing more fires, more people are sounding the alarm so he’s back.

[Continue Reading](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=92b6a32d46&e=b7b3eddce2)
---
|
---
|
### **2.[What happened to civil disagreement?](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=6f4d8ff241&e=b7b3eddce2)**

_By Beth Ann Rosica_
Earlier this month, I [reported](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=e4476075a9&e=b7b3eddce2) on threatening letters sent to people with Trump signs in their yard. One mailing included this statement, “Your vote for this guy is seen as treading on my rights. You tread on me at your peril, motherf*****.” [edited for inappropriate language]

Following publication of the story, many people reached out to me with similar situations where they felt attacked because of their political affiliations or support of specific candidates. One person said they stopped putting up yard signs because people drove onto their property to run over the signs and knock them down.

Taken in isolation, these events may not be significant — yet, when considered in the aggregate, they are alarming. And it caused me to wonder, when did civil society come to an end?

**Why It Matters**. Civility, respect, and decency are essential for our constitutional republic to survive. And perhaps, more importantly, they are imperative for our children to grow up with a sense of hope for the future. Meanwhile, campaigns continue to push negative and attacking messaging, and people become more aggressive towards the other side. This is the environment where someone thinks it is acceptable to send threatening letters or disregard 20 years of friendship.

Perhaps it is naive to hope for change, but it feels like we have reached a tipping point or a point of no return. If we cannot engage in civil discourse and disagree with one another in a non-threatening manner, Benjamin Franklin’s statement in 1787 may come to fruition. When asked whether we had a republic or a monarchy, he replied, “a republic, if you can keep it.”

[Continue Reading](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=2b684caaa9&e=b7b3eddce2)

|
---
|
# **3\. Lightning Round**
* **[Andy Bloom: Kamala can’t close](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=0b5007467b&e=b7b3eddce2)**

# **5\. What we're reading**
At the _Wall Street Journal_ , Peggy Noonan surveys the wreckage of a campaign featuring two fairly unpopular candidates and [finds reason for optimism](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=c464f376ea&e=b7b3eddce2). Everyone is energized, everyone is on edge, and the election couldn’t be closer. What does it mean? “We are saying we believe in democracy,” Noonan writes. And it’s true. Pessimists talk about rigged elections and the fix being in, but we are all acting like voting is real, effective, and will make a difference. And it will. People aren’t always going to be thrilled with the options, but democratic elections still determine who will lead this republic. There is comfort in that.

By Guy Ciarrocchi Of all the attacks on Trump, the line of attack that is most bizarre, backward, and most disconnected from reality is that he’s the cause of America’s tension, chaos and division. That’s like blaming the firemen rushing to the scene — with their alarms blaring — for making too much noise or causing the fire. Whether or not the siren is too loud, or whether it offends you or brings you comfort knowing help is on the way, the firemen are the response. Trump is the fireman. The fireman that much of the nation has been waiting for. To millions of Americans, too many of the fires are still burning. Biden and Harris allowed or encouraged some arsonists, poured gasoline on the fires, and now sit powerless watching our enemies set fires around the world. Why It Matters. It wasn’t Trump that allowed millions of illegal immigrants into our nation. It wasn’t he who didn’t vet them, or who handed them a slip of paper asking them to report to a court hearing date two years from when they crossed over. He didn’t create “sanctuary cities” or refuse to deport known criminals — even after they were arrested. He didn’t choose to deposit tens of thousands of them in small towns, allow known felons and terrorists into our nation, give them free housing, cell phones, cash and medical care — or, suggested that taxpayers pay for their gender transition surgery. It wasn’t Trump that passed legislation that helped put American manufacturers out of business — that encouraged manufacturing to move to Mexico and China. Trump is the response. And seeing more fires, more people are sounding the alarm so he’s back. | | 2. By Beth Ann Rosica Earlier this month, I on threatening letters sent to people with Trump signs in their yard. One mailing included this statement, “Your vote for this guy is seen as treading on my rights. You tread on me at your peril, motherf***.” [edited for inappropriate language] Following publication of the story, many people reached out to me with similar situations where they felt attacked because of their political affiliations or support of specific candidates. One person said they stopped putting up yard signs because people drove onto their property to run over the signs and knock them down. Taken in isolation, these events may not be significant — yet, when considered in the aggregate, they are alarming. And it caused me to wonder, when did civil society come to an end? Why It Matters. Civility, respect, and decency are essential for our constitutional republic to survive. And perhaps, more importantly, they are imperative for our children to grow up with a sense of hope for the future. Meanwhile, campaigns continue to push negative and attacking messaging, and people become more aggressive towards the other side. This is the environment where someone thinks it is acceptable to send threatening letters or disregard 20 years of friendship. Perhaps it is naive to hope for change, but it feels like we have reached a tipping point or a point of no return. If we cannot engage in civil discourse and disagree with one another in a non-threatening manner, Benjamin Franklin’s statement in 1787 may come to fruition. body:
Peter, it’s Tammy Baldwin. I wanted to take this opportunity to tell you a little more about myself, why I ran for the U.S. Senate, and why our campaign in Wisconsin is so important.
**When I was a child, I was diagnosed with a serious illness and spent three months in the hospital.** When I got better, my grandparents, who raised me, began looking for an insurance policy that would cover me in the future.
But they couldn’t find such a policy because of my previous illness. Not from any insurer. Not at any price. They had to pay for my health care out of pocket — and they had to make enormous sacrifices to do so — all because I was a child labeled with those words: "pre-existing condition."
Peter, I got into public service because I saw my grandparents stay up late at night, worried sick that I would fall ill again and that they wouldn't be able to afford my care. No one should ever have to go through that.
**Like 133 million Americans, I know what it's like to have the label "pre-existing condition" attached to my care — and before the Affordable Care Act was passed, many of us could be denied coverage.**
Today, insurance companies can no longer discriminate against someone based on their pre-existing condition. I championed health reform and fought to allow young people to stay on their parent’s insurance plan up to age 26. These policy changes have led to millions more Americans getting the health insurance they need.
So, you can imagine my frustration whenever Republicans attack our health care or threaten protections for folks with pre-existing conditions — people like me. The GOP has spent years playing politics with people’s lives. And if Mitch McConnell and his Republican megadonors flip my seat in Wisconsin and take hold of the Senate majority next election, countless Americans could find themselves in a place where insurance companies, once again, write all the rules.
The people of Wisconsin did not send me to Washington to take people’s health care away, which is why I fought against Republican repeal efforts and why I will never back down. But I can’t defend the hard-fought progress we’ve made without your help, Peter.

clean_body: Peter, it’s Tammy Baldwin. I wanted to take this opportunity to tell you a little more about myself, why I ran for the U.S. Senate, and why our campaign in Wisconsin is so important. When I was a child, I was diagnosed with a serious illness and spent three months in the hospital. When I got better, my grandparents, who raised me, began looking for an insurance policy that would cover me in the future. But they couldn’t find such a policy because of my previous illness. Not from any insurer. Not at any price. They had to pay for my health care out of pocket — and they had to make enormous sacrifices to do so — all because I was a child labeled with those words: "pre-existing condition." Peter, I got into public service because I saw my grandparents stay up late at night, worried sick that I would fall ill again and that they wouldn't be able to afford my care. No one should ever have to go through that. Like 133 million Americans, I know what it's like to have the label "pre-existing condition" attached to my care — and before the Affordable Care Act was passed, many of us could be denied coverage. Today, insurance companies can no longer discriminate against someone based on their pre-existing condition. I championed health reform and fought to allow young people to stay on their parent’s insurance plan up to age 26. These policy changes have led to millions more Americans getting the health insurance they need. So, you can imagine my frustration whenever Republicans attack our health care or threaten protections for folks with pre-existing conditions — people like me. The GOP has spent years playing politics with people’s lives. And if Mitch McConnell and his Republican megadonors flip my seat in Wisconsin and take hold of the Senate majority next election, countless Americans could find themselves in a place where insurance companies, once again, write all the rules. The people of Wisconsin did not send me to Washington to take people’s health care away, which is why I fought against Republican repeal efforts and why I will never back down. No matter how much you can give, we thank God for every one of you. Thank you, JohnCampaign ManagerHung Cao for Virginia | | Paid for by Hung Cao for Virginia | | Use of military rank, job titles, and photographs in uniform does not imply endorsement by the Department of the Navy or the Department of Defense.

Now, Debbie is running for Senate against a megamillionaire who spent $64 MILLION of his own money to buy this seat last time around. But she’s not scared. Debbie knows that just $10, about the cost of a dozen doughnuts, can be enough to change everything. Just $10 will help her run ads to fight back against Scott’s lies. Just $10 will help her hire incredible staff and travel around the state to meet voters. Just $10 will help her turn out the vote in blue districts and reach swing voters who could make or break this election. Just $10 could be enough to defeat Rick Scott and save our Senate majority. So I’m asking one final time:= | | = Thank you, Chuck Schumer | * | | | = Debbie Mucarsel-Powell is a Floridian, South American immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. She’s dedicated her life to uplifting working families, ending gun violence, and fighting for her community. Now, she’s running to defeat Republican Senator Rick Scott and win a better, brighter future for Florida.

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=29459672857d47f3a7bb0e6845c64735&_e=cAKXeDRoFIlDByAyF4zkEDfIe5_F3GS1AIC1iU6RAAxib3qp75mX9yHuroaOQ3WJLZTpeIMZ96L-FE0p_JPIdsIqGI__ieWotQZcRAmnpae5j3wfGVptMkZoOwR4AJF1ebBkrlCyNE-1jv7bS-uCsJD1sxN2MtQdUcg6kzxvOP_Id0KqMIBDIaw4IpkmWaQSTtzKmaWgBSoHQtYu4kjWivyU9UT38OuKJr5tX7nvDXiyjBi0fhbnN0pKVCZLNgb6u1V7y8TcnZDRjm0cs7xt8Vk14HHQxXdC_bTiR6PNKRh4ySoizU3ZqlcsbvC6OG83P7zwVPbgnpKfTSHwa9IqS6uAz5UmNeRAqBMSMmoYtEPeZeOlZVrFMo0lZsc_pH_rOz9oMpBgNbq06WiDbJXQ7w%3D%3D)

Peter,

I made a special trip to Ohio from South Carolina.

While we might be rivals when it comes to college football, I was glad to travel up north to help out a new friend, and someone who needs to be my colleague in the United States Senate.

**Bernie Moreno.**

Bernie is just the right person we need in the United States Senate. He’s lived the American dream. He’s worked hard and built a business. He knows what it means to provide a paycheck for his employees.

He’s standing up and running for this seat because he wants to give back to our country, which gave him so much. He wants to protect the American dream for the next generation.

He’s running against Sherrod Brown, who is one of the most reliable votes for the Harris-Biden agenda.

When President Trump wins back the White House, it’s Bernie who will work with him. Sherrod Brown will stop the Trump agenda at every turn.

That’s why we need to retire Sherrod Brown and elect Bernie Moreno. [**Will you help him?**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=29459672857d47f3a7bb0e6845c64735&_e=cAKXeDRoFIlDByAyF4zkEDfIe5_F3GS1AIC1iU6RAAxib3qp75mX9yHuroaOQ3WJLZTpeIMZ96L-FE0p_JPIdsIqGI__ieWotQZcRAmnpae5j3wfGVptMkZoOwR4AJF1ebBkrlCyNE-1jv7bS-uCsJD1sxN2MtQdUcg6kzxvOP_Id0KqMIBDIaw4IpkmWaQSTtzKmaWgBSoHQtYu4kjWivyU9UT38OuKJr5tX7nvDXiyjBi0fhbnN0pKVCZLNgb6px6AkO6pRc1VF4rVF8x6Vgi3fR0kGkdZV05vPPfsWx0IsOqPbp8_jCm8LgN45ASm_VXHG1g-_rYloqA3w-HD8fThGKbgEKfvQUDupw2r2-qxocnPBkWiibU72Nz2MjOGuOWUwvjJyKtGW-161bgiFg%3D%3D)

**Let me explain why this race is so important, and why I am asking you to help Bernie Moreno.**

1. The latest polling has him up 2 points (51% to 49%) despite being outraised by 3 to 1.
2. It’s the most expensive Senate race this cycle.
3. If Bernie wins in Ohio, we will win a Republican Senate majority.

If you’ve already given it to Bernie, thank you. [**But now I am asking you to do it again — even if it’s just $5.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=29459672857d47f3a7bb0e6845c64735&_e=cAKXeDRoFIlDByAyF4zkEDfIe5_F3GS1AIC1iU6RAAxib3qp75mX9yHuroaOQ3WJLZTpeIMZ96L-FE0p_JPIdsIqGI__ieWotQZcRAmnpae5j3wfGVptMkZoOwR4AJF1ebBkrlCyNE-1jv7bS-uCsJD1sxN2MtQdUcg6kzxvOP_Id0KqMIBDIaw4IpkmWaQSTtzKmaWgBSoHQtYu4kjWivyU9UT38OuKJr5tX7nvDXiyjBi0fhbnN0pKVCZLNgb6qHiAUtE-5TOz8QKp8IbxYvNR9FWPtpGn-xDlN79NXf1IDX7xFraRso1Mr6WFslIDuoPTBgXNYpEEu5ygZSGDrf2D5DomcrKZNjn0HqNVhYNP3mdGMQzDvCOxEdFCGBJ0_D5yBW5-FJiWFojC3RQxCQ%3D%3D)

We are so close to restoring sanity in Washington. Electing Bernie Moreno in Ohio is an important step in the right direction.

But, if we can’t close his fundraising gap, he won’t be able to help President Trump in the Senate. [**Please, chip in what you can TODAY.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=29459672857d47f3a7bb0e6845c64735&_e=cAKXeDRoFIlDByAyF4zkEDfIe5_F3GS1AIC1iU6RAAxib3qp75mX9yHuroaOQ3WJLZTpeIMZ96L-FE0p_JPIdsIqGI__ieWotQZcRAmnpae5j3wfGVptMkZoOwR4AJF1ebBkrlCyNE-1jv7bS-uCsJD1sxN2MtQdUcg6kzxvOP_Id0KqMIBDIaw4IpkmWaQSTtzKmaWgBSoHQtYu4kjWivyU9UT38OuKJr5tX7nvDXiyjBi0fhbnN0pKVCZLNgb6uu0E11jKhsqATwGj-wtgQEsFDgRD-PlOMsiN-OsLut83Yj8YMl5gcDEwgfaGV0IcrFyjFZwuXL_fY-FrmN-bNCPbN30Rqn0g3cVLEj9uV5QRzHpDcKrXjRe-1J-eoon6O0RpGpOdSEz03sCMjgKXPw%3D%3D)

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: My decision to run
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
The election ends in just two days. Tonight, I’ll meet with my team to go over our final plans on how we’re going to win it.
#

Peter,
The election ends in just two days. Tonight, I’ll meet with my team to go over our final plans on how we’re going to win it.
We’re going to need to make a series of important decisions, and what we’re able to raise in these next few hours is going to determine how much we can do to turn out each and every voter we need to win this race.
But put all that aside for a minute. Because today, I want to talk to you about another decision — why I decided to run for Arizona’s seat in the U.S. Senate in the first place.
I grew up poor. I worked hard and got into Harvard with the help of my family and community. I enlisted in the Marines, and I survived Iraq because of the guys I went through it with.
**I decided to run for Senate because this country gave me a chance. Because my family, my community, my Marines — they got me here. And because working people deserve someone who will fight for them in Washington.**
That was enough for me.
But I’ve got another reason... **Kari Lake is my opponent.**
The “MAGA Queen.” One of the only people in the country who still pushes the same election lies and conspiracies as hard as Donald Trump — the same lies that led directly to January 6th in the first place.
The polls have this race neck-and-neck. Control of the Senate will come down to who wins in Arizona — somebody who calls herself “the most dangerous politician in America,” or me.
That’s a lot of pressure. Trust me... I’m feeling it. I expect you are, too. But you are not alone in this fight. I’m with you, and thousands of others are, too.
Right now, a lot of them are making donations. They’re hoping that you will join them. Because they know that is how we will win this race.
So please, I am asking you very humbly:
[**Can you contribute $20.24 to our campaign? That’s the only way we’ll hold the Senate. The only way we’ll defend it from Kari Lake.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-nov24.6f99Bw&refcode=em241103-1-160&t=1&akid=3520%2E734936%2E8X_UQC)

body:
The future of our democracy depends on it.
#
Derek,
We wanted to share important information on how to vote in the **two days** left before Election Day.
Here’s how to vote in-person on Tuesday, how to track the status of your mail-in ballot, or request an emergency absentee ballot:
1. On Election Day -- Tuesday, November 5th -- polls are open from 7:00 am to 8:00 pm. You can [find your polling place via I Will Vote](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/50096?t=1&akid=9556%2E434096%2ElfbGeE) right now if you don’t know it already.
* Only first-time voters need to show an approved form of ID (such as a Pennsylvania driver’s license or current utility bill) to vote at the polls on Election Day.
2. If you requested an absentee ballot OR a mail-in ballot, that MUST be received by your local election official by 8:00 pm on Election Day -- again, Tuesday, November 5th. If you applied for a mail ballot, you can [track the status of your mail ballot](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/50097?t=2&akid=9556%2E434096%2ElfbGeE) online. **Do not delay in returning your ballot -- the safest way to ensure your ballot returns in time to be counted is to return it back NOW.**
3. The deadline to request an absentee or mail-in ballot has passed, HOWEVER: If you have an emergency -- such as an unexpected illness or disability or last-minute absence from your municipality -- you may still be able to obtain a mail ballot. The deadline to submit your emergency absentee ballot application to your county election office is 8:00 pm on Election Day. [You can find information here about requesting an emergency absentee ballot.](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/50098?t=3&akid=9556%2E434096%2ElfbGeE)

We know Pennsylvania is one of the most critical swing states in this year’s election, and we need everyone to show up to the polls and vote. The future of our democracy depends on it!
Lastly, John is committed to expanding voting rights to make it easier for Pennsylvanians and all Americans to vote. **[You can fund that work with a donation of $5 or more right now, and ensure that elections to come are even safer and freer.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20241103?refcode=em20241103-9556&refcode2=9556_434096_lfbGeE&akid=9556%2E434096%2ElfbGeE)**
Thanks, and happy election week!
💙 Team Fetterman
P.S. -- **If you know anyone in Pennsylvania who is on the fence about voting, or who might know how to vote, forward this email to them.** They’ll be happy to hear from you and feel empowered to vote, too.

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20241103-9556-footer&t=4&refcode2=9556_434096_lfbGeE&akid=9556%2E434096%2ElfbGeE)**

Team,

**This week – in the wake of stories of women in Georgia who died as a direct result of the state’s abortion ban – ProPublica broke the story of Josseli Barnica, a 28-year-old mother in Texas who died after being told it would be a “crime” for the hospital she went to to intervene in her miscarriage.**

Josseli spent _forty hours_ waiting, in danger of infection, until doctors felt it was legally safe for them to intervene. Forty hours mourning a pregnancy that couldn’t continue, while hoping she would make it home to her husband and daughter. Three days after she delivered, she died of sepsis.

I have seen cases like this, where patients are losing wanted pregnancies. They are heartbreaking. And there is absolutely no question what should have been done in that situation. Josseli needed immediate treatment, treatment that her doctors did not provide because of Texas’s abortion ban.

**It makes me sick. And furious.**

This is the agenda that anti-choice extremists want to take nationwide, and the one that my opponent would let states implement everywhere, including in Wisconsin. It could have happened in Wisconsin during the time when we had an abortion ban from 1849 – before the Civil War – on the books, before I challenged it and we restored reproductive rights here in Wisconsin.
**When I advocate for national action to protect reproductive health care at the federal level,_this is why_. We cannot leave this to the states.**

As late as 2021, The Hill reported that Republicans were “still benefiting from favorable maps they drew themselves after the 2010 midterm elections.”
**But this grassroots movement never backed down.**
We rallied fair maps supporters around the country. We helped states enact reforms. And heading into the 2022 elections, The New York Times declared the new map “the fairest congressional map in 40 years.”
Now, on the doorsteps of this year’s elections, we’re also looking ahead to the next round of redistricting — it’ll be here sooner than you think.
We have a comprehensive 10 Year Plan to get us all the way there — including grassroots mobilization and public education, holding legislators accountable, and advancing redistricting reforms and policy changes at both the state and federal levels. Together, we’ll protect the fair maps we’ve achieved and build a truly representative democracy.

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlononeweek?refcode=1030 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlononeweek?refcode=1030]
Friends,
We are just two days away from the most consequential election of our lifetime.
The stakes could not be higher for our country or our community.
The choice is stark: not just at the top of the ticket but here in New York’s First District. There are times in our history where a generation is called to step up and defend American democracy. This is one of those times.
And history is made by determined optimists, happy warriors who work together to overcome tough times and build a better future.
These next few days offer us the opportunity to make sure that we hand America to the next generation better than it was handed to us. I know many of you are anxious. But take it from me: the best antidote is action.
How do we see things on the ground? You probably saw my campaign manager Bryan's note. I'm so proud of the infrastructure we've built and the energy we are seeing across the district.
We’re seeing record turnout in Suffolk County and across America. From everything I'm seeing, voters are energized. They know the stakes. They're doing what they can.
But in these last 72-plus hours (hours!), we need to do more.
If you haven't yet - you can still help us make a huge difference.
Volunteer to knock on doors, phone or text. [https://www.mobilize.us/nysdems/event/715622/?referring_vol=6598131&share_context=dashboard-event-details&sharer_role=SharerRole.ORGANIZER]
We need to earn this victory and it could come down to a few thousand votes.
What we know is that our vote matters here in NY-01. We could determine whether Democrats retake the House.
And regardless of who wins the presidency, the House is going to decide so much. If Kamala Harris wins, we can do so much together to rebuild the middle - starting by taking direct action on affordability. Restoring the state and local tax credit. Making it less expensive to have kids and buy a house. And of course, protecting reproductive freedom nationwide.
But if, God forbid, Donald Trump wins the White House, a Democratic House is essential to the defense of American democracy. We can't afford to give him a rubber stamp.
We're seeing real energy here up and down the ticket. In these closing hours, I'm reminded just what "happy warriors" can really do. Campaigning with energy, courage, and joy.
Thank you for being with me on this journey, and of course for fighting the good fight with me.
-John
PS: Our field program is the best in the state and among the best in the country. We are still expanding it - going to get every last vote. If you can pitch in now, it really still does make a difference - allowing us to contact more voters and get out more votes. Please consider contributing, one last time. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlononeweek?refcode=em]
-John

Hi, friend! I wanted to share what keeps me grounded during this crazy time.
| | |
---
Friend, every Sunday my mom and I spend the afternoon playing dominoes together. It's our special tradition — and it's one of the most meaningful parts of my life.
[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96473367/510108551/849749119?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=&refcode=jtk2403-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYmU4N2E1NzctZmY5OS1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=U7CgPNcly_y6PwoZKTdTI7BnXkV2gbQNJvWA200xi40=)
I owe just about everything in my life to my mom. She made the brave decision to move my family from our home in Ecuador to America. It wasn't easy moving to a new country as a 14-year-old, but I can't imagine what it was like for my mom, having to start all over and working double shifts just to pay rent for a one room apartment.
But friend, my mom never wavered once. **Her constant reassurance, work ethic, and firm belief in the American dream inspired me to fight for a better life.**
I studied hard, got a minimum wage job, and earned scholarships to pay for college. After school, I found a career giving back to my community through public service, eventually becoming the first South American immigrant elected to Congress. I've found purpose in my life, become part of a unique community, and raised a beautiful family.
**Because of my mom's sacrifices, my family got our American dream. And now, it's both a privilege and a joy to be my mom's caretaker, ensuring that she can age with dignity and comfort.** There are a lot of big things that come along with that job — managing her doctor's appointments, advocating for her care, and navigating the all-too-complicated Medicare and Social Security systems.
But it's the little parts of caring for my mom — playing our weekly domino games, cooking a big dinner for her, taking her on trips to her favorite places — that matter most to me.
My ability to give my mom a good retirement is one of the things that I am most grateful for. It's not easy by any means, but I know all too well just how lucky my mom and I are. **These days, it's getting harder and harder for Americans to age with dignity and comfort.**
Far-right Republicans have fought for major cuts to Social Security and blocked efforts to expand Medicare, leaving seniors living paycheck to paycheck. Instead they want to cut or privatize these critical public programs — my opponent Rick Scott actually came up with a plan to _end_ them altogether. Even though I've been able to give my mom a good retirement, the shortcomings of these programs still make it incredibly hard to get her the care and support she needs.
**Every American deserves a good, stable retirement. That's why I'm running for Senate — to fight for people like my mom.[Polls show that we've got a real chance to win, but I'm counting on your help to power my grassroots campaign. clean_body: Hi, friend! I wanted to share what keeps me grounded during this crazy time. | | | Friend, every Sunday my mom and I spend the afternoon playing dominoes together. It's our special tradition — and it's one of the most meaningful parts of my life. = I owe just about everything in my life to my mom. She made the brave decision to move my family from our home in Ecuador to America. It wasn't easy moving to a new country as a 14-year-old, but I can't imagine what it was like for my mom, having to start all over and working double shifts just to pay rent for a one room apartment. But friend, my mom never wavered once. Her constant reassurance, work ethic, and firm belief in the American dream inspired me to fight for a better life. I studied hard, got a minimum wage job, and earned scholarships to pay for college. After school, I found a career giving back to my community through public service, eventually becoming the first South American immigrant elected to Congress. I've found purpose in my life, become part of a unique community, and raised a beautiful family. Because of my mom's sacrifices, my family got our American dream. And now, it's both a privilege and a joy to be my mom's caretaker, ensuring that she can age with dignity and comfort. There are a lot of big things that come along with that job — managing her doctor's appointments, advocating for her care, and navigating the all-too-complicated Medicare and Social Security systems. But it's the little parts of caring for my mom — playing our weekly domino games, cooking a big dinner for her, taking her on trips to her favorite places — that matter most to me. My ability to give my mom a good retirement is one of the things that I am most grateful for. It's not easy by any means, but I know all too well just how lucky my mom and I are. These days, it's getting harder and harder for Americans to age with dignity and comfort. Far-right Republicans have fought for major cuts to Social Security and blocked efforts to expand Medicare, leaving seniors living paycheck to paycheck. Instead they want to cut or privatize these critical public programs — my opponent Rick Scott actually came up with a plan to end them altogether. Even though I've been able to give my mom a good retirement, the shortcomings of these programs still make it incredibly hard to get her the care and support she needs. Every American deserves a good, stable retirement. That's why I'm running for Senate — to fight for people like my mom.= If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | = | | = | | = | | = Thank you so much, Debbie | * | | | = Debbie Mucarsel-Powell is a Floridian, South American immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. | **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

| **Lost Your Ballot? Still Fed Up Enough to Vote?**
---
| You can show up at any vote center in your county and request a new ballot to vote.
You can also register while you're there, if you're not registered to vote.
Don't know how to vote? Stuff on the ballot too confusing?You don't have to vote on everything - you can leave things blank.

**Peter's recommendations:**
* Vote for anything but "Democratic"

We have a Democrat supermajority in our state and they've gone crazy with many of their **anti-** family, **anti-** small business, **anti-** religion, **anti-** law & order policies. The Federal government has suffered greatly under Democrat leadership. It's time for change!

* State Ballot Propositions

Just say NO to any more spending. The only YES I'd recommend is Prop 36, which partially repeals the original Prop 47 that gave criminals the green light to steal up to $950 without felony charges.

* **Vote for Peter Hernandez for Congressional District 18!**

**Where to find a vote center** Live in Monterey County?[Polling Place and Voter Information Guide Lookup](https://hernandezforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=314f047675baff18221b82bdc&id=d1b7332ced&e=638e6c2751)

Santa Cruz County?[Vote Center & Drop Box Locations](https://hernandezforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=314f047675baff18221b82bdc&id=2a91006431&e=638e6c2751)
All vote centers are open from now through Election Day on Tuesday - **you must vote before Tuesday evening**.
Your vote matters! It's really important that good people vote.
If you need any assistance, please don’t hesitate to contact me at 831-610-4555.

_Here are the three most important things you need to know:_

**EXPERTS RANK MULTIPLE DEMOCRATIC SENATE SEATS AMONG THE MOST VULNERABLE.**

Look -- if Republicans flip just TWO seats, they'll take back Senate control and enforce a hard-right agenda on the entire nation. And right now the GOP is targeting our most vulnerable senators.

_It gets worse:_

**SENATE REPUBLICANS SAW RECORD-BREAKING FUNDRAISING LAST CYCLE.**

I won't beat around the bush: Senate Republicans and their megadonors have outraised us numerous times. That means they have the resources to blanket America in attack ads, pack thousands into MAGA rallies, and bankroll campaigns to take back the Senate. Meanwhile, Democratic fundraising is _down_ compared to previous elections.

_As a result:_

After the 9/11 attacks of my senior year of high school, I went off to the Naval Academy at 17 years old. Like so many veterans of my age, I felt the strong call to serve, to defend this country.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96476032/510117442/1582103613?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1071-bu-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNjNiY2MxMC0wNTlhLWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9tIM0wmEaJ0m4QBsDo7WmJw-HogQhqeXaLzgGXh-Ad4=)
That service took me all over the world: two deployments at sea and a tour on the ground in Iraq. That decision to serve changed my life and still impacts me today, just as it does for so many of my fellow veterans.
I took an oath to defend and serve our Constitution and this country. So when I saw people who call themselves “patriots” storm the Capitol to overthrow our government and the results of the 2020 presidential election, I was furious.
I refuse to stand by and let election deniers and conspiracy theorists take control of our government. I’ll fight day in and day out to defend our democracy, our right to vote, and every freedom that we hold dear.
And here’s the deal: We have the chance to defend our democracy by taking back the House on Tuesday.

body:
Friends, we have just 48 hours until this election is over, have you voted? Have you made plans for Tuesday night? ...
| | | | [](https://ghwh6lbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001A7nrzH1wnhhwcMXyeu3dnTVdtJGi9xnjtA3uzW7vjoLZT84OXpaFLshchbvUyUZqkXoJ7X9rRcIVtggQFd063PMRFk7oGvMZ6IK8MVlGEj4NYjnYLmgsZ0Jt-uU648koEtevIOTgQPitzjxGIWjh0A==&c=aFVnJ8CLwMR9HpZAEEQef5_5mDG8fr_wa_E6soTcWF-jpk4n3FZtzg==&ch=Uu1T4esECJ-nTzB1qfbeNL7LMjHINcj_PQmP6EiaV36xgYZqfxq1yA==)

| Friend, There are less than 48 hours until the 2024 election is decided, and the fate of our nation is sealed.
Here at Team Imer, we have been participating in ballot-chasing efforts all week by sending thousands of text messages to voters in Jefferson County and have seen a bump in turnout from those efforts.
As the end of the election year draws near, I again invite you to join us on Election Night in Lakewood, CO, as we watch President Trump be elected as our country's 47th President!
Ticket prices are to cover the cost of the event which is $1,500.
As a new organization, we regret that we could not cover the cost for attendees, but we hope that with your support, we can hold events like this one for free in the future.
The Team Imer PAC has an incredible event planned for everyone at Baldoria On The Water in Lakewood, CO.
Join us for light appetizers, drinks, music, special guests, and more!
Any candidates for State and Federal office are invited to attend and speak.
Ticket prices start at just $15 for Gen Z attendees and $20 for Adults and General Admission. War Room access and additional ticket options are also available.
For tickets, click the image or button below:

They were racist, insulting, and entirely unacceptable. _**Ya no más.**_ Any person or party who espouses this kind of vile rhetoric against other humans — let alone citizens of the United States — is unfit to run the White House. **And anyone who would tie themselves so closely to a candidate who does, like Rick Scott, has no business in any position of power — especially in Florida.** **[Please split $25 or more between Defeat Boebert PAC now to help me reach my $10 million goal and build the resources to retire him from the Senate.](http://links.defeatboebertpac.com/u/click?_t=c3d87ac674644038b5146447a156028d&_m=f254cbef579a4ea1a8edd2b3d5b3f3e9&_e=fs7PwIUiFWygF99ARs4KgGL6z7lioyRVXxAN20Rc6SNzOz15PTwmywJNcyhfN6v3OtXb0TIX_AlrOvCnbhGRMiKhw1aHkahh66kL3RRXDch4J3-2KsxA-NYPkUFByOWikt0IwzlzMhODK_aTMA5hVvZrMoSKXkgnp-i5pS9irU4U_X3D9UZsxv340Z1BdjwWMD5zCwuAsIsM7mf-5w3wwEsdE6-zE5VRF9AlYLwfh7B-SGzsFRNN3Q33Wsh_TDaKENjOWAcvH7GquouWHgoe_AEk01t47n1Y-Nyos_AA6JPneS7eGLfNug6UlqdEL3T9boILzzMy-DB8avA-4mRIjdaW2S4TPwh5e6ObYXKKFUZtKqes8uRXbHpoS3gcGfc-MzZU0Ues554y_qNDm8Ou7jdUhGLk_neR9bR_07SSDQ-sR5v7ql3vlhxCZla91v-W)** And what's more, Peter, is that they know full-well that what they're doing is wrong — and they're terrified of facing the consequences. _How am I so sure?_ Well, when I went to vote yesterday, I had the displeasure of running into Rick Scott myself, as he rallied Miami Republicans in a misguided attempt to try and intimidate me for social media clicks. **As soon as he saw me there, he sped off in his chauffeured getaway car.** _Disappointing?_ Yes. _Surprising?_ Hardly. It's just who he, Donald Trump, and the GOP are: **Bigots, cowards, and losers.** First, Rick took a note out of Trump's playbook when he refused to debate me. Then, he comes to my home district and doesn't even have the courage to face me, not to mention answer for his puppet-master's despicable attitudes. Now, he's panicking, and desperately trying to placate Florida's large Puerto Rican population, whose votes he's courting to win and stay in power. **The best way he could earn our forgiveness now is by leaving my people in peace, starting by staying out of politics entirely. Sadly, cowards like him don't have the decency to do the right thing and leave us be.** But with the massive fortune he used to buy the 2018 election, he won't leave without a groundswell of Florida voters saying _**ya no más,**_ too. And with just 2 days left in this race, I won't galvanize the movement to unseat him if I can't make my crucial $10 million goal by midnight. **In short, I can't bring him to account at the ballot box | **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

name: Jill Stein
subject: UN Report: We are plunging“headlong into climate disaster.”
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=climate_update&n=1)
---
Peter,

The latest climate report issued by the UN makes it clear that even the words crisis and emergency are insufficient now.

UN Secretary General Antonio Guterres said it himself: **We are plunging “headlong into climate disaster.”

** For years, experts told us a +1.5°C increase from pre-industrial levels would be catastrophic – the point of no return that had to be avoided at all costs.

That goal was the basis of the Paris Climate Accords; a matter of survival for low-lying nations in the Global South; and a matter of long-term survival of the human species.

In late 2023, new research predicted we would hit +1.5°C in 2024, and that we were on a collision course with +2°C.

**Now? We’re SURGING towards 3.1°C warming** – DOUBLE the calamity scenario that has been the anchor of all climate legislation for decades.

**I will not sugarcoat this: 3.1°C threatens the very survival of our species. We are still well below that threshold and already experiencing deadly superstorms, crop failures, and mass climate migration.

** This news comes on the heels of DEVASTATING floods that swept Appalachia, wiping out entire towns, taking lives and livelihoods with them.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=climate_update&n=2)
---
Just a few days ago, similar flooding slammed into Valencia, Spain and the surrounding region, after more than a YEAR’S worth of rain fell in the course of 8 hours.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=climate_update&n=3)
---
Each of those storms killed OVER 200 people. And they are a drop in the bucket of the climate disasters headed our way.

The UN’s report this week did not hesitate to get to the point, dedicating the first page of their 100 page report to a single message in big red letters:
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=climate_update&n=4)
---
**What is evident throughout this report, from the title to the closing citations, is that not a single major, developed nation has accepted responsibility for repeatedly prioritizing corporate profits over human survival, nor taken any of the measures necessary to change course.

**[**We need a president who understands that human survival is NOT negotiable, and willing to take the radical measures necessary to guarantee that. That’s what you will get from a Stein-Ware administration.**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=climate_update&n=5)
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=climate_update&n=6 "DONATE") [DONATE](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=climate_update&n=6)
---
The UN report makes it clear that the United States is the single biggest barrier to enacting the policies we need at the global scale – due in large part to endless militarism and genocide.

**If the Pentagon and all its attendant agencies were a country, it would be one of the largest carbon emitters in the world. This is hidden from both the public and the policymakers by the fact that weapons manufacturers like Boeing “exclude” their military contracts from their corporate climate portfolios.

** Each time we perpetuate and facilitate armed conflict, we are massively increasing those carbon emissions.

Israel has dropped so many American bombs on Gaza, now spreading into Lebanon, that the total explosive yield is many times more than the number dropped on Dresden during WW-II. In fact, the total munitions are equivalent to multiple atomic bombs.

Even if the kinetic warfare were to end immediately, far more carbon emissions will be required to rebuild what Israel has destroyed with their genocidal campaign.

All this leads to a grim conclusion: If the war doesn’t kill you, the climate disaster will.

**The climate emergency doesn’t care how rich you are, how big your house is, or even how much political power you wield. It’s coming for all of us if we do not radically alter course.**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=climate_update&n=7 "DONATE") [DONATE](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=climate_update&n=7)
---
I’ve been fighting for climate justice my entire life because I know that change is mandatory – _and I also know it is possible.

_ I’ve seen people rise up and mobilize in the face of a crisis time and again. I know that the solutions are within our grasp and that we have the collective capacity to save our planet and our people.

As your president, I will declare a climate emergency on DAY ONE and immediately begin mobilizing the full force of the federal government to respond to the crisis _AS a crisis_.

[**You can read more about my plans for climate justice here.**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/platform?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=climate_update&n=8#the_real_green_new_deal) As always, thank you for being in this fight with me.

In solidarity and gratitude,

Jill

The UN’s report this week did not hesitate to get to the point, dedicating the first page of their 100 page report to a single message in big red letters: What is evident throughout this report, from the title to the closing citations, is that not a single major, developed nation has accepted responsibility for repeatedly prioritizing corporate profits over human survival, nor taken any of the measures necessary to change course. | "DONATE" The UN report makes it clear that the United States is the single biggest barrier to enacting the policies we need at the global scale – due in large part to endless militarism and genocide. If the Pentagon and all its attendant agencies were a country, it would be one of the largest carbon emitters in the world. This is hidden from both the public and the policymakers by the fact that weapons manufacturers like Boeing “exclude” their military contracts from their corporate climate portfolios. Each time we perpetuate and facilitate armed conflict, we are massively increasing those carbon emissions. Israel has dropped so many American bombs on Gaza, now spreading into Lebanon, that the total explosive yield is many times more than the number dropped on Dresden during WW-II. In fact, the total munitions are equivalent to multiple atomic bombs. Even if the kinetic warfare were to end immediately, far more carbon emissions will be required to rebuild what Israel has destroyed with their genocidal campaign. All this leads to a grim conclusion: If the war doesn’t kill you, the climate disaster will. The climate emergency doesn’t care how rich you are, how big your house is, or even how much political power you wield. It’s coming for all of us if we do not radically alter course. | "DONATE" I’ve been fighting for climate justice my entire life because I know that change is mandatory – and I also know it is possible. I’ve seen people rise up and mobilize in the face of a crisis time and again. I know that the solutions are within our grasp and that we have the collective capacity to save our planet and our people. As your president, I will declare a climate emergency on DAY ONE and immediately begin mobilizing the full force of the federal government to respond to the crisis AS a crisis. As always, thank you for being in this fight with me. In solidarity and gratitude, Jill | "Support Jill Today!" **Knock, knock, knock.**

_It’s the scariest sound you’ll hear when you live in a communist country._

_It’s the last sound my parents heard when their fathers were taken away._

_It’s the sound of always living in fear, and it’s my family’s real-life story._

We escaped from Vietnam just days before Saigon fell to the communists, and we were given a new life in the most generous country on Earth.

**America saved my life, and I dedicated my life to paying her back.**

I graduated from the United States Naval Academy and served for 25 years in Navy Special Operations in Iraq, Afghanistan, Somalia, and Pakistan and 40 other countries around the world.

I love this country - but right now, it’s taken a dark turn.

Now, the knocks are coming from Joe Biden’s Department of Justice. Sending two dozen armed agents to arrest a pro-life activist in front of his family. Raiding gun shops and seizing records from law-abiding gun owners. Arresting his challenger in the next election.

_And he’s doing it all while real criminals are free to roam our streets._

We are losing our country. You know it. But you also know we can save it.

I’ve been all over the world. Believe me when I tell you, if America fails, there is nowhere else to go.

**It’s time to save America while we still have a chance.**

**I’m Hung Cao, retired Navy Captain, and I’m running for the United States Senate.**

Fellow Conservative,

We’ve entered the final weekend of this race. **With the fight for Wisconsin’s battleground Senate race still rated a TOSS-UP,** the success of our entire campaign will come down to this final weekend.

That means, we need to leave it all on the field over the next few days. Our ads need to be running constantly, and we need an army of volunteers out in communities across Wisconsin turning out voters in record numbers.

Bernie is just the right person we need in the United States Senate. He’s lived the American dream. He’s worked hard and built a business. He knows what it means to provide a paycheck for his employees.

He’s standing up and running for this seat because he wants to give back to our country, which gave him so much. He wants to protect the American dream for the next generation.

He’s running against Sherrod Brown, who is one of the most reliable votes for the Harris-Biden agenda.

When President Trump wins back the White House, it’s Bernie who will work with him. Sherrod Brown will stop the Trump agenda at every turn.

That’s why we need to retire Sherrod Brown and elect Bernie Moreno. [**Will you help him?**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=0a99173588d04e6f82e3708d8216eb0f&_e=7PDmZGLyAJ95c_YKBMThBr_ToZ0s2MANeOfuRpohhTbjl_ygJflSdwiYXsTafKjiazmhuCvSa3GenES6yLJe2wFQZpoW_FJhuIKjleyEXKN2We-hKY3PwR2CW4xuWaETOwVF8nrZsNuXxuTDlgmHE-A8f5cYbnJ5bNgsOYgwhZWBZj3Dtq5lEXtJxABR7bGCCglKcL5HqreygddW4IsMtitzDkEr9oiOIbwhOkR4g5UHeIbHBb1xro5NK8lZSEZE5k5m4j3yFMj622HHPJCwfwq-71jDSUbTfPVVr9A_2vxRMN3JivHtGWN9RqbJbe5qp4BnBif2rvay80Tqj7_Wlx3hGeb-B65hPJk1uW29Y2U8xZXAWHYNa2kNA2pnFahTLpb9XxVsqjuEaX4R78Frkw%3D%3D)

**Let me explain why this race is so important, and why I am asking you to help Bernie Moreno.**

1. The latest polling has him up 2 points (51% to 49%) despite being outraised by 3 to 1.
2. It’s the most expensive Senate race this cycle.
3. If Bernie wins in Ohio, we will win a Republican Senate majority.

If you’ve already given it to Bernie, thank you. [**But now I am asking you to do it again — even if it’s just $5.**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=0a99173588d04e6f82e3708d8216eb0f&_e=7PDmZGLyAJ95c_YKBMThBr_ToZ0s2MANeOfuRpohhTbjl_ygJflSdwiYXsTafKjiazmhuCvSa3GenES6yLJe2wFQZpoW_FJhuIKjleyEXKN2We-hKY3PwR2CW4xuWaETOwVF8nrZsNuXxuTDlgmHE-A8f5cYbnJ5bNgsOYgwhZWBZj3Dtq5lEXtJxABR7bGCCglKcL5HqreygddW4IsMtitzDkEr9oiOIbwhOkR4g5UHeIbHBb1xro5NK8lZSEZEdp2HtY36yMX5u8LWHf2OhcQmvzCxLr3wDkZSxZIfgd0pbuwO21Os9SdiYeskS-Vqki9wNOoRBso4__CAGj7vXGEWjRlATuLoDy9TMXjHlV9QfYst2KdAr-pr5ZMVepfApZWopoPukTf6_gLPglp6NQ%3D%3D)

We are so close to restoring sanity in Washington. Electing Bernie Moreno in Ohio is an important step in the right direction.

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

The last day to vote in the 2024 general election is this Tuesday,
November 5th. While it’s unclear who will win the critical presidential
election or gain majority control of Congress, one thing is for sure:
AIPAC had a massive influence on this election cycle.

While AIPAC has been around for decades, they only started contributing
directly to political candidates in the 2022 midterms — now, the
right-wing megadonor-funded group is one of the largest outside spenders
in our elections.

The Intercept published a new report revealing just how much the
anti-Palestinian lobby group has impacted political races in the United
States this year. Here are the major takeaways:

* AIPAC spent in more than 80% of all congressional races, seeking to
influence 363 seats in the House and 26 in the Senate, leaving very
few races untouched by their right-wing money.

* The group supported more Republicans than Democrats, but spent more
money supporting conservative, so-called Democratic candidates who
challenged and unseated progressive Squad members Jamaal Bowman and
Cori Bush in the two most expensive House primaries in history.

* After every single one of its wins this cycle, AIPAC tweeted, “Being
pro-Israel is good policy and good politics!” While it won most of its
races, 57 of AIPAC’s candidates had no primary and 88 had no opponent.

subject: How I’m feeling

body:
I wanted to make sure you know how I’m feeling about this week.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20241103-4486-footer&t=1&akid=4486%2E420207%2EnA8RWC)
Hi Peter, it's Pramila here.
I wanted to make sure you know how I’m feeling about this week. On Tuesday night, polls will close in an election that will change our country forever — for better or for worse.
After spending weeks canvassing and engaging with voters in Washington and in swing states across the country, **I believe that voters will make the right choice.** But we owe it to ourselves to do everything we can until the moment polls close.
I know that with Kamala Harris in the White House and Democratic majorities in Congress, **we’ll have the opportunity to move the country forward.** By restoring reproductive rights, expanding Medicare, raising the minimum wage, strengthening unions, and so much more.
But right now we’re up against a deadline none of us can ignore – the most important one we’ve had since we beat Donald Trump the last time in 2020.
**Our campaign is relying on grassroots donations from people like you** to get over the finish line AND bring Kamala Harris and Democrats in tough districts along with us, so we can take back Congress and move forward with our agenda.
[**The final 48 hours will be critical, and we simply must stay strong. That’s why I’m asking: can you chip in $3 or more to support us in our final push?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20241103?refcode=em20241103-4486&amount=3&refcode2=4486_420207_nA8RWC&akid=4486%2E420207%2EnA8RWC)
**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20241103?amount=3&refcode=em20241103-4486&refcode2=4486_420207_nA8RWC&akid=4486%2E420207%2EnA8RWC)**
We cannot slip up now — not with the polls as tight as they are in the most important election of our lifetimes.
**Everything from our progressive agenda to our democracy itself hinges on the next 48 hours.** And I’m determined to do everything I can to make sure we succeed.
But none of us can do it all alone, so I need your help in this critical final stretch. We’re in this together, and we have to make every second count.
[**I believe so strongly in our grassroots movement, and I’m hoping to see our power with the donations we bring in over the next 48 hours. Will you be one of the donors to get us across the finish line when it really matters?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20241103?refcode=em20241103-4486&amount=3&refcode2=4486_420207_nA8RWC&akid=4486%2E420207%2EnA8RWC)
I KNOW we can do this — thank you for your time and support today,
Pramila
**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-footer?refcode=em20241103-4486-footer&t=2&refcode2=4486_420207_nA8RWC&akid=4486%2E420207%2EnA8RWC)**

Derek --
**With Election Day less than two days away, we want to be sure you’ve voted early or know how and where you will vote on Election Day in Pennsylvania.**
This election will come down to a handful of votes, and we need to ensure every single voter turns out to help secure wins for Kamala Harris, Tim Walz, and Democrats nationwide.
Head to **[IWillVote.com/Pennsylvania](https://iwillvote.com?state=natl&refcode=em_20241103_2200_do&utm_source=dnc_organizing&utm_source=dnc_organizing&utm_campaign=em_ak_iwv_do_dvc_ve_20241103_dnc_natl_na_na_na&utm_medium=em)** to find your polling location, hours, and information you need to cast your ballot.

Thanks for making your voice heard and for everything you do for Democrats,
The Democrats

**If Thursday night made anything clear, it’s that Josh Hawley is wrong for Missouri.**
Instead of telling voters about any actual accomplishment during his time in the Senate or his vision for the future, Hawley spewed the same lies about me that he’s spent millions of dollars to air on TV since August. And that says a lot.
He doesn’t want to talk about his career-long crusade to restrict reproductive freedoms like abortion, birth control, and IVF.
He thinks it’s acceptable that he hasn’t brought back even one dollar of congressionally directed spending to Missouri.
And he’s desperate to make Missourians forget about the fact that he’s never actually in Missouri — only returning here an average of six times per year.
**Missourians need a real warrior for working people fighting for them in the U.S. Senate — and unlike Josh Hawley, I’m ready to serve.** But I need your help over these next 2 days to make sure every voter knows about their choice in this election, especially with a new poll showing this race in a statistical tie. Friend,

My name is Andrew Hayman - I am the Field/GOTV director for the Colorado Turnout Project. Our main focus this cycle has been unseating Lauren Boebert in Colorado 4th Congressional District.

The National Democratic Party (DCCC) has largely ignored this race, similar to how they ignored it in 2022 despite the final outcome of the race coming down to just 500 votes. We understand there are so many frontline races in play right now, and we aren’t trying to criticize them; this is just the reality we face. As such, we are one of the _only_ Democrat-aligned PACs focused on this race.
**Here’s a snapshot of some of the work we’re doing to unseat Boebert and flip this seat blue** :

* We will be driving hundreds of low propensity voters to the polls through our work with Rideshare2Vote
* We’ve hired dozens of paid canvasser who are working tirelessly with the CO Dems Coordinated Campaign on hitting key high population neighborhoods in Boebert’s districts
* We’re funding local democratic parties and volunteer groups at the county level to support grassroots organizing
* Running hard-hitting ads aimed at dissuading GOP voters and getting our folks out to the polls

**
We cannot afford to give up on this race like the national party did in 2022.** Data is showing that Boebert faces _immense skepticism_ from her new constituents and this is our last opportunity to defeat her before she consolidates power and cements herself in her new district.

clean_body: | | We are one of the only Democrat-aligned PACs in this race against Boebert. | | | | | Friend, My name is Andrew Hayman - I am the Field/GOTV director for the Colorado Turnout Project. Our main focus this cycle has been unseating Lauren Boebert in Colorado 4th Congressional District. The National Democratic Party (DCCC) has largely ignored this race, similar to how they ignored it in 2022 despite the final outcome of the race coming down to just 500 votes. We understand there are so many frontline races in play right now, and we aren’t trying to criticize them; this is just the reality we face. As such, we are one of the only Democrat-aligned PACs focused on this race. Here’s a snapshot of some of the work we’re doing to unseat Boebert and flip this seat blue : We will be driving hundreds of low propensity voters to the polls through our work with Rideshare2Vote We’ve hired dozens of paid canvasser who are working tirelessly with the CO Dems Coordinated Campaign on hitting key high population neighborhoods in Boebert’s districts We’re funding local democratic parties and volunteer groups at the county level to support grassroots organizing Running hard-hitting ads aimed at dissuading GOP voters and getting our folks out to the polls We cannot afford to give up on this race like the national party did in 2022. Data is showing that Boebert faces immense skepticism from her new constituents and this is our last opportunity to defeat her before she consolidates power and cements herself in her new district. | | | If it's within 500 votes again like last cycle, organizing over the weekend can and will get out those hundreds of voters that we need — money given today will help us text voters and knock their doors over the weekend, on Monday, and up until polls close on Tuesday. We have less than 50 hours until E-Day. These critical hours are when real persuasion can happen and when we can make sure that low propensity voters make plans to get to the polls. This isn’t just some run-of-mill backpack; it really is a game changer... because a few recognized survival experts put their minds together and helped develop this {incredible bag}.

They designed it to withstand the rigors of hiking, camping, fishing and traveling.

You can literally kick its ass and it'll never skip a beat.

That alone makes it hella special.

But there's more ... oh man, so much more... [I'll throw you some highlights here.](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/18979/6374453/3a9a19f4187d0e1172b6528e66e0ad0c359d5d57/c272456ea2740bd8fccaf66afad31a1e38bc45b6)

And one of my favorite features... the multi-military-style compartments that this bag has that will help you stay organized like a true pro.

All those compartments combined gives you a whopping 42 liters of storage. You can cram it full and still have room for more.

Also, don't forget to look inside... you'll find some interior storage surprises too!

And of course the ventilated mesh padding on the back and shoulder straps means you won’t feel weighted down - ever.

Throw in an adjustable chest strap as well to provide even more support, making long hikes or trips a breeze.

So there you have it...

Whether you need a[ {bug-out bag, a three-day assault pack, or a sleek laptop day pack}](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/18979/6374453/3a9a19f4187d0e1172b6528e66e0ad0c359d5d57/c272456ea2740bd8fccaf66afad31a1e38bc45b6), this bag adapts and conforms to your lifestyle while keeping you COMFORTABLE.

It’s perfect for both urban adventures and off-grid excursions.

And currently there is an unbeatable deal going on.

You can test one out for ZERO cost. You just pay shipping.

But time is ticking.

[{Hurry before the offers ends!}](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/18979/6374453/3a9a19f4187d0e1172b6528e66e0ad0c359d5d57/c272456ea2740bd8fccaf66afad31a1e38bc45b6)

Adventure awaits!

subject: Trump wants to protect women? Absolutely NOT.
body:
alt [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
Did you catch this madness the other day?
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241103_trump_protecting_image [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241103_trump_protecting_image]
That was Donald Trump speaking at a rally in Wisconsin, telling the crowd that some of his advisors urged him to stop saying he wants to protect women. His answer?
“So what? I’m president.”
“Well, I’m going to do it. Whether the women like it or not, I’m going to protect them.”
Honestly, it made my SKIN crawl.
This is a man who has been repeatedly accused – DOZENS of times – of sexual abuse and harassment. Last year, a jury found him liable for sexual abuse AND for defaming the woman he assaulted in a civil case.
This is the man who pals around with known sexual predators. And he wants to protect us?
The whole thing is extremely creepy, even threatening. But this is how Donald Trump, JD Vance, and men like Jim Jordan view women.
The same Jim Jordan who is an abuse enabler and has protected a sexual predator for years.
We’re up against an extremist agenda that’s not just insulting but downright dangerous.
If men like Trump and enablers like Jim Jordan stay in power, they’ll keep pretending to be our “protectors” while stripping us of our autonomy and shielding predators.
We can end their reign of terror on Tuesday, and we are so close you wouldn’t believe it! Our campaign is SURGING, and we’re gaining ground with Independent and Republican voters who are sick of this nonsense.
We are putting every last penny we raise into getting out the vote on Tuesday. Will you donate $25, $50, or whatever you can to help us send Jim Jordan packing and finally put real advocates for women’s rights in power? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241103_trump_protecting_link]
Jim Jordan, who has consistently voted against the Violence Against Women Act and repeatedly turned his back on survivors of sexual abuse, is positioning himself as a “leader” in Congress.
With just days left before Election Day, it’s up to us to send a message: Women don’t need “protecting” by men who dismiss, silence, and ignore us.
We need leaders who will respect our voices and legislate for our rights.
So let’s FIRE JIM JORDAN on Tuesday and show these creeps that we are NOT GOING BACK!
Thanks for standing with us – not as our so-called “protectors,” but as true partners in change.
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

#

Election Day is just 48 hours away.
We’ve been racking our brains trying to figure out how to convince you to make your first donation before we run out of time.
We figured the best way was to be completely honest with you. So, here goes:
The polls have this race tied. Kari Lake may be a bit ahead, but we’re close. We’re confident we can win if we raise what we need to finish the job. But frankly, we’re flat broke.
It’s okay — don’t panic yet. We planned for this.

--**Nella Domenici**

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

| | | Friend, it's Martin Sheen. **I'll try to keep this brief.

My friends at the DSCC are doing everything they can to save our razor-thin Democratic Senate majority, and with just 2 days left before the election, every little bit helps. [So can I count on you to chip in $5 _(matched to become $20)_ to defend the Senate?](https://go.dscc.org/go/20460?amount=5&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20241103-MartinSheen-SheenXDaysFR-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20241103-MartinSheen-SheenXDaysFR-Pros-sl1&akid=18744%2E9716520%2E3XcPv0)**

body:
