Derek, I know I'm sending you a lot of incredibly urgent emails about my race in Nevada these days. **But today, I want to take a step back and share the story of how I first got involved in politics.**
In 2016, while I was serving as the president of my synagogue in Nevada, Senator Harry Reid recruited me to run in a competitive House race to help flip a red seat blue. Looking back, it's incredibly fitting that _this_ was my entry point to public service – because my Judaism helps guide much of my work in the Senate today.
In fact, my decision to say "yes" and run for public office in the first place was guided by the Jewish principle of Tikkun Olam – which means to leave the world a better place than how we found it.
Now, as the third Jewish woman and only former synagogue president in Senate history, I'm proud to serve Nevada and our country. And I'm as committed as ever to keep fighting to better this world and make positive change happen. **But I need your help.**
**The _Cook Political Report_ has been calling Nevada the “most perilous" battleground for Democrats. And as we enter the final stretch of this race, polls now show me losing crucial ground to my extreme MAGA opponent.**
**So please, I have to urgently ask:[If the principle of Tikkun Olam resonates with you – if you're with me to continue making progress for the people and communities that we love – will you split $10 or more between my campaign and Adam Schiff to keep Nevada blue so Democrats can defend both our Senate majority and the White House? ](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=nov2024_abs_em_rosen.uBCgVw&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20241103_PM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=3&akid=8140%2E5257348%2EvfKxF2)**

# 3 Days Left—Final Call for Mail Ballots, Donations, and Ad Funds!

But there’s still more we need to do. As we push through these last few days, our campaign is working non-stop to reach every voter, and we need your help to **finish strong**.
Here’s how you can make an impact in these final hours:

River Gassen

* Lowering the price of insurance in Montana, while guaranteeing access to high-quality insurance that is reliable, consistent and doesn’t disappear when you need it - at fair prices.

body:

Join me, Senator Van Hollen, Congressman Raskin, House Democratic Whip Katherine Clark, Comptroller Lierman, County Executive Fitzwater, and many more for a GOTV Rally in Frederick before Election Day!

We're all coming out to support our friends Angela Alsobrooks and April Delaney in the final days of the election — and we hope you’ll join us!

Here are the details:
GOTV Rally
Monday, November 4 from 4-5 PM ET
Bushwaller's
209 N Market St
Frederick, MD 21701

RSVP » [https://www.mobilize.us/mdvictory/event/739661/?utm_source=em20241103-1]

Elevate,

Wes Moore

#

The lives of Montanans are on the verge of being changed forever, and it all comes down to Election Day.
As many of us get ready to go to the polls on Tuesday, we have the future in mind. The votes we make today will determine not just who wins elections, but who guides the future we envision for our families, state, and communities.
[**I’ll cut to the chase: I need your help more than ever in the final days of this race.**](https://lynchformontana.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=179e5534b0fac3e64994314a9&id=ddce5679c7&e=9e9e92f018)

As a candidate to be Montana’s next Chief Justice of the Montana Supreme Court, I am committed to being impartial and am committed to protect your rights as established by the Montana State Constitution and established legal precedent. **Knock, knock, knock.**

_It’s the scariest sound you’ll hear when you live in a communist country._

_It’s the last sound my parents heard when their fathers were taken away._

_It’s the sound of always living in fear, and it’s my family’s real-life story._

We escaped from Vietnam just days before Saigon fell to the communists, and we were given a new life in the most generous country on Earth.

**America saved my life, and I dedicated my life to paying her back.**

I graduated from the United States Naval Academy and served for 25 years in Navy Special Operations in Iraq, Afghanistan, Somalia, and Pakistan and 40 other countries around the world.

I love this country - but right now, it’s taken a dark turn.

Now, the knocks are coming from Joe Biden’s Department of Justice. Sending two dozen armed agents to arrest a pro-life activist in front of his family. Raiding gun shops and seizing records from law-abiding gun owners. Arresting his challenger in the next election.

_And he’s doing it all while real criminals are free to roam our streets._

We are losing our country. You know it. But you also know we can save it.

I’ve been all over the world. Believe me when I tell you, if America fails, there is nowhere else to go.

**It’s time to save America while we still have a chance.**

**I’m Hung Cao, retired Navy Captain, and I’m running for the United States Senate.**

**[If you’re all-in to defend the greatest country on Earth, join our team today.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=da3b06ab6d9c43048a36f6b62da352ad&_e=rjScEYpw0EO2ArGzM65pohg4NhiFYNN3n-XnYijU78dqmMLGGiHqgUzxe8gSVou7O9_fZ6KqeLmE3NzC7i7u3XMn7rIMjvJVIVNJSE3gi78MOP3jQ2RSMWfS41qB_Ztvyt4BTjYn8-JzTOqR3VYuWBNGN9bVBybKgBfglYlrMlrkYkF8SaFk5z1t0T2Doxyz4eUy5gaMpNjce8be3AuHlOFQvjkLLqqsA2h7_w8UfROh-89Cw2kJfh7b3l5cj2A4mH8EYa7Gj8x2ZZtRpuSz9nTpDWw8nJ-9Nc2VdVl61-LLEiqOojtRUke0epKM5u77FhVrFHKQTwXln8kdw-LsjqHb6rL8zeap3u4jLIKsgXfJYWQ5LM4L5axxHBe_k1di)**

[**JOIN THE TEAM - STAND WITH ME TODAY**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=da3b06ab6d9c43048a36f6b62da352ad&_e=rjScEYpw0EO2ArGzM65pohg4NhiFYNN3n-XnYijU78dqmMLGGiHqgUzxe8gSVou7O9_fZ6KqeLmE3NzC7i7u3XMn7rIMjvJVIVNJSE3gi78MOP3jQ2RSMWfS41qB_Ztvyt4BTjYn8-JzTOqR3VYuWBNGN9bVBybKgBfglYlrMlrkYkF8SaFk5z1t0T2Doxyz4eUy5gaMpNjce8be3AuHlOFQvjkLLqqsA2h7_w8UfROzpKmYHmZYoal3bO7Xqg8FfsCWwFfVfLXuwOQEtMZ0iE_XHnlt3b3cIDs7u8zMwon-00bg15mEMXvRFV87sxhpKyBwYio22oWc58iSJ5nTeqq1XYUAYQz9bCaAd8rEQtaeR6lV9Nt_2YVMCa8c_jtv)

I still believe America can be the land of opportunity, Fellow Patriot.

And as someone who owes their life to the American Dream, I have an obligation to fight back against those who have trampled on it.

We need REAL fighters. Not politicians, not bureaucrats, and not keyboard warriors acting tough in custom made suits.

If we’re going to preserve our freedoms, we can’t be intimidated. We must be fearless.

**[It’s time to fight for the American greatness that lies within us. I spent my career defending our country as a U.S. Navy Captain. I’d like to give you my closing argument for why it’s so important for you to step up before the final votes are cast. What happens in this election will determine the rest of our country’s future. Elites like Tim Kaine want to concentrate power in the hands of the few. He’s working with power brokers like the Clintons and the Obamas to make sure the government works for special interests, not hardworking citizens like you. He’s playing the same games the communist party was using to seize power before my family and I were able to escape Vietnam. I love America too much to let it go down that path, and if you do too, I need you to step up. We have a real shot at winning this race. But that doesn ’ t mean it ’ ll be easy. Tim Kaine has outspent us nearly 3:1. He has an elite team of political professionals that are trying to spin lies about me and every patriot who is working for a stronger Virginia and a stronger America. Reaching voters and setting the records straight will take a lot of resources, and I can’t call on celebrity donors like my opponent can. Even with just two days until Election Day there’s still a TON of undecided voters in our Commonwealth, and I need your help to reach them. America’s future is on the line. If we win this race, we have a clear path to take back the Senate and get our great country back on track. name: AOC
subject: Where do you get a sense of hope in times like this?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
A lot of people ask me, “Where do you get a sense of hope or optimism from in times like this?”
For me, I’ve always gotten that from you all: my fellow Americans. The fact that **there are people willing to stand up and demand the maximum for our future**.
We have inherited an unfair world. We have inherited a world where prior generations of leadership have set the table so that companies get richer and richer, and people's incomes stay the same or get even lower.
We have inherited a world where we had to grow up practicing for school shootings because our leaders are too cowardly to stand up to the NRA and gun manufacturing companies and say “No more.”
We _had_ an assault weapons ban until 2005. We _had_ tuition-free colleges and universities in the 1970’s. We _had_ record investments in housing — public housing, social housing, and more — generations ago.
**But when we stand up and say, “We’d like some of those things again,” we’re called _extreme_**. There is nothing extreme about trying to work for a living and put food on the table.
**I refuse to leave an unfair world to generations to come**. We will make sure that we leave a different world. One where people can work 40 hours a week, put food on the table, afford their housing, and live a decent life.
And if people want to call me “extreme” for believing that? **Bring it on**.
If you want to call me “extreme” for thinking any person should have rights over their body? **Bring it on**.
If you want to call me “extreme” for acknowledging the Congressional Budget Office assessment that immigrants brought in trillions of dollars in U.S. revenue and paid more taxes than Elon Musk or these other folks? **Bring it on**.
**We have nothing to fear**. There is nothing to fear in moving forward into a better future.
In solidarity,
Alexandria

Kennedy told the crowd of 13,000 that for the last 19 years, he has been praying every day when he gets out of bed that God will put him in a position to end the chronic disease epidemic so we can restore health to our children.

[](http://links.americanlibertyalert.com/u/click?_t=3c9a9e018cb54768aae32f693c7987c9&_m=5dad9675e4f5460faabf1a8d23556835&_e=dnl5IymYbRHWyVnFa1PLb8f9KC23DWjGeddX2p1w-9N1A8fYG8nkf9Tzd-qH30r7hGEMnst2aragbHvni4rw6InsXoff-BkdhViZaiFDipmkBwB6GvqvHGF9Q4HfexfXHRlcrNgD5I6Sqp0G8dYcQ19nCd_p4Ek5C5kIO-eoLfgv61pf4SBB1OhbIOEgzuMsWr3HQXNvFUd_WNp1duLcAfBHPKeNSFZZ-XVP8iO1ngZrY3awqBWXMIr9AufO-XDnNGQLsJhqLm6x55cfuDVdBeegg7H-6gHM7m5QnOyhVg8olozkRW4duMXwMWHIbF-VuKPJF0lBzm-BwHH5JPXsCP-TAMSYeSseMH2EqV1oclQ2IIBmuJpTwXcqoudmvpb0mIoV30ZO3Rp1ZnQNOFADSQ%3D%3D)

Fellow patriot,

I made a special trip to Ohio from South Carolina.

While we might be rivals when it comes to college football, I was glad to travel up north to help out a new friend, and someone who needs to be my colleague in the United States Senate.

**Bernie Moreno.**

Bernie is just the right person we need in the United States Senate. He’s lived the American dream. He’s worked hard and built a business. He knows what it means to provide a paycheck for his employees.

He’s standing up and running for this seat because he wants to give back to our country, which gave him so much. He wants to protect the American dream for the next generation.

He’s running against Sherrod Brown, who is one of the most reliable votes for the Harris-Biden agenda.

When President Trump wins back the White House, it’s Bernie who will work with him. Sherrod Brown will stop the Trump agenda at every turn.

That’s why we need to retire Sherrod Brown and elect Bernie Moreno. [**Will you help him?**](http://links.americanlibertyalert.com/u/click?_t=3c9a9e018cb54768aae32f693c7987c9&_m=5dad9675e4f5460faabf1a8d23556835&_e=dnl5IymYbRHWyVnFa1PLb8f9KC23DWjGeddX2p1w-9N1A8fYG8nkf9Tzd-qH30r7hGEMnst2aragbHvni4rw6InsXoff-BkdhViZaiFDipmkBwB6GvqvHGF9Q4HfexfXHRlcrNgD5I6Sqp0G8dYcQ19nCd_p4Ek5C5kIO-eoLfgv61pf4SBB1OhbIOEgzuMsWr3HQXNvFUd_WNp1duLcAfBHPKeNSFZZ-XVP8iO1ngZrY3awqBWXMIr9AufO-XDnI_WEHj3afKM8WKGFWDeZsNoYT6YkRjpZ6o3iJv5cuNTjMpnsNPrju7akqSElawxoiiFtNm8aV7SqKMgpKnsxpI2O1k9zjm9IBQWGFK9BawIHHjQ6-GkwCz45pTB6nzNDipEUskkNr3HI8MivvKJusw%3D%3D)

**Let me explain why this race is so important, and why I am asking you to help Bernie Moreno.**

1. The latest polling has him up 2 points (51% to 49%) despite being outraised by 3 to 1.
2. It’s the most expensive Senate race this cycle.
3. If Bernie wins in Ohio, we will win a Republican Senate majority.

If you’ve already given it to Bernie, thank you. [**But now I am asking you to do it again — even if it’s just $5.**](http://links.americanlibertyalert.com/u/click?_t=3c9a9e018cb54768aae32f693c7987c9&_m=5dad9675e4f5460faabf1a8d23556835&_e=dnl5IymYbRHWyVnFa1PLb8f9KC23DWjGeddX2p1w-9N1A8fYG8nkf9Tzd-qH30r7hGEMnst2aragbHvni4rw6InsXoff-BkdhViZaiFDipmkBwB6GvqvHGF9Q4HfexfXHRlcrNgD5I6Sqp0G8dYcQ19nCd_p4Ek5C5kIO-eoLfgv61pf4SBB1OhbIOEgzuMsWr3HQXNvFUd_WNp1duLcAfBHPKeNSFZZ-XVP8iO1ngZrY3awqBWXMIr9AufO-XDnkVQ1H3KrNS3-5Bv2jQs7deqaFibq9XAGCYRdszkKQbKiGv1j_-AYQqgNM5RUNowowgbMmXK1Xg7gQBvBPdL0DhNZB5klEmM5SXaCg7IoXbzUchylygz5Y2T8oBKcGO5UNlBwpxfQtQOMej7McFv74g%3D%3D)

We are so close to restoring sanity in Washington. Electing Bernie Moreno in Ohio is an important step in the right direction.

But, if we can’t close his fundraising gap, he won’t be able to help President Trump in the Senate. [**Please, chip in what you can TODAY.**](http://links.americanlibertyalert.com/u/click?_t=3c9a9e018cb54768aae32f693c7987c9&_m=5dad9675e4f5460faabf1a8d23556835&_e=dnl5IymYbRHWyVnFa1PLb8f9KC23DWjGeddX2p1w-9N1A8fYG8nkf9Tzd-qH30r7hGEMnst2aragbHvni4rw6InsXoff-BkdhViZaiFDipmkBwB6GvqvHGF9Q4HfexfXHRlcrNgD5I6Sqp0G8dYcQ19nCd_p4Ek5C5kIO-eoLfgv61pf4SBB1OhbIOEgzuMsWr3HQXNvFUd_WNp1duLcAfBHPKeNSFZZ-XVP8iO1ngZrY3awqBWXMIr9AufO-XDnrHDLEaBkf93j5sOgsTVVzO3fpBjYCRhjspwuWzEIZpQGGXFE6MWSsJsFQk_SLCImYaLrm6Ejma89du3zWhIUIzFyZQRNpLIuLlk3bzo3E6AGjnqFZM50x00RBrPoOJsjoT595Re3u9sdqhtPyD0tjw%3D%3D)

Thank you,

Right now, with just **two** **days** until the final votes are cast, we’re seeing Republicans lay the groundwork to subvert the will of the people if the election doesn’t go Donald Trump’s way. EMILYs List began in 1985 with a mission to support Democratic pro-choice women running for office. Our guiding principle was: Women should be at every decision-making table in politics. It was (and still is) a pretty simple idea. **As it turns out, a lot of revolutions start with pretty simple ideas**.

The other EMILYs List foremothers and I founded this organization because the political establishment at the time did not believe women could win elections. This became a self-fulfilling prophecy when they refused to support women candidates. **We knew it was time for a change. clean_body: And this can be the year that vision comes full-circle | = Peter, EMILYs List began in 1985 with a mission to support Democratic pro-choice women running for office. Our guiding principle was: Women should be at every decision-making table in politics. It was (and still is) a pretty simple idea. As it turns out, a lot of revolutions start with pretty simple ideas. The other EMILYs List foremothers and I founded this organization because the political establishment at the time did not believe women could win elections. This became a self-fulfilling prophecy when they refused to support women candidates. We knew it was time for a change. We were determined to open doors so women had a fair chance to compete — and to win. | = Well, the doors are certainly open now. And I am so thrilled to be saying this to you, Peter: After 39 years of movement-building and growing political power for women, we have the chance this year to break the highest, hardest glass ceiling of all. This can be the year we send an EMILYs List woman to the White House. There is still time to be part of the wave that helps elect Kamala Harris and the hundreds of other women EMILYs List has endorsed this cycle, up and down the ballot. --**Nella Domenici**

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

body:
Here’s how your donation could make a big impact with two days left
#
The finish line is in sight!
We’re just two days away from Election Day, but there’s still plenty of time to make a difference and help Sarah win.
Campaigns are conversations, and there are a lot of voters left to reach and turn out before the polls close on Tuesday. A donation of $5 from you today will be put immediately to work to help us leave it all on the field.
[**So, can you pitch in $5 or as much as you can to get Sarah across the finish line?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20241103-1?refcode=em20241103-1536&amount=5&refcode2=1536_21716_bdLaaR&akid=1536%2E21716%2EbdLaaR)
Here’s exactly how your donation today could make a big impact with two days left:
* **$10** will help cover software and sending costs to contact hundreds of extra voters. A few hundred texts can mean dozens of last-minute commitments to vote for Sarah.
* **$25** can pay for a round of coffee or snacks for our dedicated volunteers making calls and knocking on the doors
* **$50** can fund gas and supplies to put out more yard signs and distribute literature at the polls that highlight Sarah’s vision for bold change — from affordable healthcare and housing to paid leave
* **$100** will help us boost our digital ads to reach undecided voters as they make their decision on who to vote for on Election Day

Even $1 makes a powerful difference, with hundreds of people pitching in.
But our fundraising has slowed down at this pivotal moment. With so much uncertainty around the presidential race and U.S. Senate elections, we need to ensure that we did everything we could have to flip the House — and that means electing Sarah and keeping Delaware’s seat blue.
[**Pitch in now to power our last-minute get-out-the-vote efforts.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20241103-1?refcode=em20241103-1536&refcode2=1536_21716_bdLaaR&akid=1536%2E21716%2EbdLaaR)

Michaela

body:
[1]Lucas Kunce for U.S. Senate

Peter — I’m a born-and-raised
Missourian.

And if Josh Hawley had his way, my kids would not be alive today.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83475?refcode=em20241103-8617&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=8617%2E614464%2EhQb_wl ]Photo of Andy with his kids.

I know that might sound dramatic, and this is a long email. But if you
give me just a couple minutes of your time to explain, I know you’ll agree
— [ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83475?refcode=em20241103-8617&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=8617%2E614464%2EhQb_wl ]and I hope you’ll then chip in to help Lucas Kunce defeat Josh Hawley
this Tuesday.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83475?refcode=em20241103-8617&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=8617%2E614464%2EhQb_wl ]CHIP IN NOW

It might be easy to assume I’m talking about Hawley’s continued opposition
to marriage equality. He even voted against it in 2022. While Josh Hawley
does seem to care a lot about what happens in my bedroom, I’m actually not
married — just gay.

While it’s safe to assume Hawley’s opposition to civil rights protections
for gay Americans means he doesn’t want me to be a parent anyway, his
assault on my right to build and raise a family has a lot more to do with
reproductive freedom — something that matters to each and every one of you
reading this.

Like many Americans — women, men, gay, straight — I had to rely on IVF to
build my family. I’m so incredibly thankful for the doctors, donors, and
rockstar surrogates who helped bring my kids into the world. Those women
gave me life. They gave me the chance to have a family. And I will be
forever indebted to them.

My son Ben was born in 2019, and my daughter Lucy was born in 2022 — just
a few months before the Dobbs decision. As any parent with IVF kids can
tell you, it isn’t easy. It’s expensive, takes time, and often fails.
Fertilized embryos will almost inevitably be lost, and the costs
associated with indefinite storage means extra embryos are almost always
either donated to research, donated to family, or discarded. It’s an
immense privilege to be able to build a family with IVF, when it should be
a right.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83475?refcode=em20241103-8617&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=8617%2E614464%2EhQb_wl ]St. Louis Public Radio headline: 'No protection for IVF' Missouri
advocates sound alarm after IVF safeguards stymied in legislature.

Now, two years after Dobbs, we’re living in an America that has less
freedom than it did before — from a total abortion ban in Missouri and IVF
shutdowns in Alabama, to “fetal personhood” laws (which Missouri also has)
that threaten reproductive freedom in its entirety.

And no U.S. Senator is more personally responsible for it than Josh Hawley
— who is now up for his first election since everything changed.

You might already know about Josh Hawley’s extreme anti-choice views and
how he’s used his taxpayer-funded office to support his wife's legal work
in the Dobbs case and in the case to ban the abortion pill nationwide —
[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83475?refcode=em20241103-8617&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1005&akid=8617%2E614464%2EhQb_wl ]and if that’s reason enough for you to want to help Lucas Kunce defeat
Hawley in November, then add a donation to help Lucas get it done.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83475?refcode=em20241103-8617&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1006&akid=8617%2E614464%2EhQb_wl ]CHIP IN NOW

But if you didn’t already know about Josh Hawley’s deep personal
involvement in every single part of the nationwide assault on reproductive
freedom, then keep reading.

It all started when Hawley led the Hobby Lobby case in front of the
Supreme Court, which gave employers the power to refuse coverage for birth
control for their workers. He even said contraceptives “may induce an
abortion by preventing implantation of a fertilized egg” — which, to be
clear, is not true or what an abortion is according to virtually every
medical professional.

Once Hawley got to the U.S. Senate, he did everything he could to push his
extreme anti-reproductive freedom agenda forward: Putting campaign donors
as well as anti-IVF and anti-surrogacy extremists on our courts. Using his
taxpayer-funded office to support his activist-lawyer wife's cases to
overturn Roe, enacting Missouri’s total abortion ban, and even trying to
ban the abortion pill nationwide. And sponsoring extreme “fetal
personhood” bills at the national level.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83475?refcode=em20241103-8617&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1007&akid=8617%2E614464%2EhQb_wl ]On the left, a headline from The Guardian: Hawley's anti-abortion
arguments echoed in AL IVF case. On the right, a headline from the
Washington Post: Nominee who is anti-IVF and surrogacy was deemed
unqualified. Hawley: 'I was proud to recommend her.'

Then, Hawley made it clearer than ever how he feels about IVF and our
right to build a family: He voted against a bill to guarantee access to
IVF and make it more affordable. His reason?

Hawley told the media the Right To IVF Act was really part of an “abortion
agenda.”

I’m sorry, but that’s CRAZY.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83475?refcode=em20241103-8617&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1008&akid=8617%2E614464%2EhQb_wl ]CHIP IN TO FIGHT BACK

His ultimate goal here is obvious — Josh Hawley doesn’t just want Big
Brother politicians like himself to control us in our bedrooms and our
doctor’s offices. He wants to control OUR bodies, and even how we choose
to build and raise OUR families.

And if he gets another six years to finish what he’s started, then the
ability to build a family like mine — or even likely a family like yours —
could be made impossible.

Josh Hawley poses a unique and existential threat to reproductive freedom,
and this is our one chance to put a stop to his crusade against our
freedoms. [ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83475?refcode=em20241103-8617&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1009&akid=8617%2E614464%2EhQb_wl ]We can’t afford to give him another six years in the U.S.
Senate — so, I'm asking: Can you please add a donation to Lucas Kunce’s
campaign today so we can secure our freedoms?

If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your
contribution instantly:

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83476?refcode=em20241103-8617&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=1010&akid=8617%2E614464%2EhQb_wl ]Contribute $10

wanting to tell you a bit more about Lucas Kunce and why I know he can
defeat Josh Hawley — but only if he has your help. Lucas is the Marine
veteran and born-and-raised Missourian taking Hawley on this November.
He’s built a record-breaking movement and is drawing huge crowds at events
across the state.

And he’s even sharing the ballot this November with a referendum to end
the Hawley-backed abortion ban in Missouri, which will be a huge boost for
Democratic turnout just as it has been in red and purple states across the
country in recent elections.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83475?refcode=em20241103-8617&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1017&akid=8617%2E614464%2EhQb_wl ]New York Times headline: Abortion Rights Fuel Big Democratic Wins, and
Hopes for 2024

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83475?refcode=em20241103-8617&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1018&akid=8617%2E614464%2EhQb_wl ]CHIP IN TO ELECT LUCAS

Not long ago, Missourians came together to defeat Todd Akin after his
extreme views on abortion came to light, but that didn’t happen overnight.

Akin exposed himself in August of that election year, and a poll that same
month showed him with an 11% lead. It took weeks and MONTHS of hard work,
advertising, and organizing to expose Akin’s extremism to Missouri voters
— and because we all came together, Missourians rejected Akin on Election
Day by a 15% margin (a total change of 26% from August).

And while you might be surprised to hear about Democrats doing that well
in a red state, that kind of result isn’t rare in Missouri.

In our last U.S. Senate race that took place in a presidential election,
Jason Kander outperformed the presidential ticket by 16%, nearly defeating
incumbent Roy Blunt, who had the entire GOP establishment behind him. In
fact, the race against Blunt got close with almost identical timing to the
race against Akin — Kander was polling by as much as 14% behind Blunt, but
after pushing hard on ads and organizing starting in the fall, the race
was neck-and-neck.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83475?refcode=em20241103-8617&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1019&akid=8617%2E614464%2EhQb_wl ]On top, a Spectrum News headline: Recent poll found Hawley was the
least popular GOP senator up for reelection among voters. In the middle,
AP headline: Missouri abortion-rights campaign turns in more than double
the needed signatures to get on the ballot. On the bottom, a quote from
Jason Kander in the KC Star: 'Lucas Kunce can defeat Josh Hawley. Anyone
who cares about democracy, reproductive freedom, and working families,
this race should be a priority.'

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83475?refcode=em20241103-8617&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=8617%2E614464%2EhQb_wl ]CHIP IN TO BEAT HAWLEY

Now I’m going to say something you may not want to hear, but it is true
and important for this race: Josh Hawley is more extreme than Donald Trump
and almost every Republican on reproductive freedom. In fact, he
objectively has the worst record on reproductive rights of any U.S.
Senator. That means we don’t have to wait for Hawley to have a “Todd Akin
moment” — his entire six years in the Senate has been one.

But it’s an election year, which means Josh Hawley will be telling all
sorts of lies to voters claiming he’s not responsible for this assault on
our freedoms. And that’s where you and me come in.

We need to help Lucas expose Hawley’s anti-freedom crusade to Missouri
voters on TV, online, at their doors, and in their mailboxes, and that

[ ]New York Times headline: Abortion Rights Fuel Big Democratic Wins, and Hopes for 2024 [ ]CHIP IN TO ELECT LUCAS Not long ago, Missourians came together to defeat Todd Akin after his extreme views on abortion came to light, but that didn’t happen overnight. Akin exposed himself in August of that election year, and a poll that same month showed him with an 11% lead. It took weeks and MONTHS of hard work, advertising, and organizing to expose Akin’s extremism to Missouri voters — and because we all came together, Missourians rejected Akin on Election Day by a 15% margin (a total change of 26% from August). And while you might be surprised to hear about Democrats doing that well in a red state, that kind of result isn’t rare in Missouri. In our last U.S. Senate race that took place in a presidential election, Jason Kander outperformed the presidential ticket by 16%, nearly defeating incumbent Roy Blunt, who had the entire GOP establishment behind him. In fact, the race against Blunt got close with almost identical timing to the race against Akin — Kander was polling by as much as 14% behind Blunt, but after pushing hard on ads and organizing starting in the fall, the race was neck-and-neck. [ ]On top, a Spectrum News headline: Recent poll found Hawley was the least popular GOP senator up for reelection among voters. In the middle, AP headline: Missouri abortion-rights campaign turns in more than double the needed signatures to get on the ballot. On the bottom, a quote from Jason Kander in the KC Star: 'Lucas Kunce can defeat Josh Hawley. Anyone who cares about democracy, reproductive freedom, and working families, this race should be a priority.' [ ]CHIP IN TO BEAT HAWLEY Now I’m going to say something you may not want to hear, but it is true and important for this race: Josh Hawley is more extreme than Donald Trump and almost every Republican on reproductive freedom. In fact, he objectively has the worst record on reproductive rights of any U.S. Senator. That means we don’t have to wait for Hawley to have a “Todd Akin moment” — his entire six years in the Senate has been one. But it’s an election year, which means Josh Hawley will be telling all sorts of lies to voters claiming he’s not responsible for this assault on our freedoms. And that’s where you and me come in. We need to help Lucas expose Hawley’s anti-freedom crusade to Missouri voters on TV, online, at their doors, and in their mailboxes, and that takes resources. [ ]So if it wasn’t clear already, your support could make all the difference in this race — will you join me in helping Lucas beat Josh Hawley by donating any amount you can today to his campaign? If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: [ ]Contribute $10 [ ]Contribute $25 [ ]Contribute $30 [ ]Contribute $50 [ ]Contribute $100 [ ]Contribute $250 [ ]Give another amount Thank you so much for taking the time to read this, Peter. I hope you’ll join me in supporting Lucas. Andy Cohen

alt [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
If you are a senior or have a senior in your life, you should know this: Jim Jordan has consistently turned his back on those who need support the most.
He wants to cut Social Security and Medicare—lifelines for millions who’ve worked hard their whole lives. He even voted against capping prescription drug costs, denying relief to seniors struggling to pay for life-saving medications.
If you have a veteran in your life, it’s important to know that Jim Jordan voted against the PACT Act, legislation designed to provide healthcare to veterans exposed to toxic substances while serving our country.
For someone who claims to champion patriotism, he sure doesn’t show up for those who’ve sacrificed the most.
Jordan pretends to care about farmers, but his voting record tells the truth. If you know a farmer, be sure to tell them Jordan has voted against EVERY farm bill for the past 17 years!
If you or someone you love lives with a disability, Jim Jordan’s record is just as grim. He’s voted against measures that would protect and support people with disabilities, leaving them to face barriers without the resources they need.
Jim Jordan has made it clear: when it comes to showing up for those in need, he’s nowhere to be found.
If you or someone you know falls into any of these groups, it’s time for real representation. Help us show Jim Jordan the door by contributing today and fighting for leaders who stand up for everyone – not their own extreme agenda. This shows why we can't afford to write off even one single state in our fight to protect voting rights. RUSH $25 or more right now to make sure every vote truly counts in our elections >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=110324_3&amount=25]

Team,
There's no way to sugarcoat this: A major party is advocating for a constitutional change in Texas that would codify their power and control into the state constitution . From the Austin American-Statesman:
" The Texas Republican Party platform now calls for a state constitutional amendment to create another requirement for winning statewide office: In addition to winning the most votes statewide, a candidate would have to win a majority of the votes in a majority of Texas’ 254 counties. "
This would create a mini-Electoral College just within Texas itself, with one vote for each county. Harris County, home to Houston and nearly 5 million people, would count exactly the same as Loving County, whose population during the 2020 census was recorded as 64 people .
For example, Texas' current governor won reelection with only 55% of the popular vote but "won" 235 counties. This constitutional amendment, if passed, would guarantee no other party could win a statewide election without taking away all those rural, deeply conservative counties. Opponents of voting rights want to use land, not people, to keep themselves in power permanently.
They're openly advocating for anti-democratic rules to limit the impact of people's votes just because they want to stay in control, Team. --**Nella Domenici**

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

**Nella Domenici**
Republican for Senate

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Peter,

In just two days, you'll be making a critical decision that could shape our country for years to come. But before you make that choice, I need to make sure you understand what's at stake.

The Congress of 2020 was the most productive Congress in history. We had a blue House, a blue Senate, and a blue White House – and we used that advantage to pass some real legislation for the American people.

But since Republicans took back the House, all progress has stalled. We've seen disarray and dysfunction like never before. It's time we hold these leaders accountable, and the best way to do that is at the ballot box.

We have a real shot at taking back the House in these next two days. Polls show this is anyone's election to win – it's up to us to make sure Democrats come out on top.

_Our race here in Washington's 8th District is going to play a vital role in that fight._ There is no path to a Democratic House majority that includes losing vulnerable blue seats like ours. We have to hold the line on November 5, but I need your help to do that.

**I'm so proud to fight for Washingtonian families every single day, and I'm so grateful to have you on my team in this monumental moment.**

clean_body: I fight for Washingtonian families every single day, and I'll never give in to political games or personal agendas. Peter, In just two days, you'll be making a critical decision that could shape our country for years to come. But before you make that choice, I need to make sure you understand what's at stake. The Congress of 2020 was the most productive Congress in history. We had a blue House, a blue Senate, and a blue White House – and we used that advantage to pass some real legislation for the American people. But since Republicans took back the House, all progress has stalled. We've seen disarray and dysfunction like never before. It's time we hold these leaders accountable, and the best way to do that is at the ballot box. We have a real shot at taking back the House in these next two days. Polls show this is anyone's election to win – it's up to us to make sure Democrats come out on top. Our race here in Washington's 8th District is going to play a vital role in that fight. There is no path to a Democratic House majority that includes losing vulnerable blue seats like ours. We have to hold the line on November 5, but I need your help to do that. The outcome of this election could determine control of the People’s House. With so much at stake, we can’t afford to look back on November 6th wishing that we had done more.

| Peter,

I hate to bother you on a Sunday, but the stakes of this election are just too important. I’m doing everything in my power to defend this open seat – but I need your help.

The outcome of this election could determine control of the People’s House. With so much at stake, we can’t afford to look back on November 6th wishing that we had done more.

My opponent is as extreme as they come. Granite Staters deserve a leader who will stand up for reproductive freedom, defend the integrity of our democracy, and fight to secure a fair deal for hard-working families. Not a MAGA loyalist who is a rubber stamp for Trump's extreme Project 2025.

These last 2 days are absolutely critical to our success. If you can, I hope you will consider making a contribution to our campaign to help us secure any last-minute resources we’ll need to fight for every vote right up until the last voter casts their ballots!

name: Jen O'Malley Dillon
subject: If you’re already thinking about Election Night, I hope you will read this email.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Harris for President
body:
|
---
[](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1142?refcode=kh_em_do_20241103_b19_jod_tier1_do_do_fl_ak-srg&amount=47&amounts=47%252C75%252C100%252C250%252C500&utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241103_b19_jod_tier1_do_do_fl_ak-srg&t=1&akid=253%2E2563979%2EcUWKmc)
Peter, we’re two days out, and I wanted to send you a quick field guide for the next few days. **This race continues to be extremely close. I know that can cause some anxiety. But let me just say again: We are going to win. It's just going to take every single one of us to do it.** **[If you have a few hours or even a few minutes to spare, sign up to make calls or knock doors whenever fits in your schedule to help make it happen>>](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1218?utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241103_b19_jod_tier1_do_do_fl_ak-srg&t=2&akid=253%2E2563979%2EcUWKmc)** | | [SIGN UP](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1218?utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241103_b19_jod_tier1_do_do_fl_ak-srg&t=3&akid=253%2E2563979%2EcUWKmc)
---
* * *
**_What We’re Seeing On the Ground_**
We feel very, very good about where we are. More people -- and more diverse people -- are voting than ever before. We are currently on pace to turn out the voters we need to get to 50%+1 in each battleground state.
We continue to have a few paths to victory: By winning the Blue Wall (Wisconsin, Michigan, and Pennsylvania), by winning the Sun Belt (Nevada, Arizona, Georgia, and North Carolina), or by winning a combination of the two. We are seeing what we need to see to pull at least one of those paths off.
Volunteers knocking on doors, making calls, and making sure voters have what they need to head to the polls are making a difference in this race. **So much so that undecided voters in the last week are breaking for the Vice President by double-digit margins.**
We know that, among the remaining pool of undecided voters, more are open to voting for the Vice President than for Trump. Our team on the ground is kicking ass reaching those voters and we have to keep it up in the days to come.
**_What to Expect on Election Night_**
Every state counts votes differently. Some wait until polls close, some start counting as soon as voters submit their ballot. That means that returns are going to come in for different states at different times. This is roughly what we expect to see:
[](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1218?utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241103_b19_jod_tier1_do_do_fl_ak-srg&t=4&akid=253%2E2563979%2EcUWKmc)
It will take a long time to count every single vote, and we can’t place too much stock in the early returns. The tally in certain states is going to change a lot as additional ballots are counted. For example, some states that count absentee ballots first may start off blue and shift to red as time goes on. Those would be your Michigans and Pennsylvanias.
[](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1218?utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241103_b19_jod_tier1_do_do_fl_ak-srg&t=5&akid=253%2E2563979%2EcUWKmc)
On the other hand, there are states like North Carolina, Arizona, and Nevada where we may see Republicans leading from the beginning and then those states may shift to blue as urban areas come in and more late early vote and vote-by-mail is counted.
**We may not know the results of this election for several days. But we must stay calm and confident during that period of time.** We all have a role to play to ensure that our friends, family, and neighbors trust our electoral process.
**_What About Trump?_**
Look, Donald Trump is probably going to come out early on Election Night and claim victory despite the facts -- just like he did in 2020. We can count on him spinning a web of misinformation about the way this election was held and challenging the results when he loses again. It will have no impact whatsoever on the outcome of this race. Tune it out.
**The truth is this: Our elections are among the most transparent government processes and our systems will hold.** The non-partisan decision desks at media outlets that are watching this race closely are not going to be swayed by what Donald Trump says. _And we should not be either._
Rest assured that if Trump and his friends try to claim they won this election and throw their bag of tricks at us, we are prepared. We have some of the best lawyers on our team and they are ready to go to court to ensure that every vote is counted.
**_How You Can Help_**
If that all makes you anxious, that is okay! Join the club. But let me tell you this: How you take action now will really matter come Election Night.
_**How many doors we knock, how many phone calls we make, or how many of our neighbors we get to the polls in the coming days could determine the outcome of this election.**_
**[Our campaign is looking for more supporters from Cresco to volunteer to help reach undecided voters in these final few days. Will you sign up now?](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1218?utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241103_b19_jod_tier1_do_do_fl_ak-srg&t=6&akid=253%2E2563979%2EcUWKmc)**
| [SIGN UP](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1218?utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241103_b19_jod_tier1_do_do_fl_ak-srg&t=7&akid=253%2E2563979%2EcUWKmc)
---
Our team will give you all the training you’ll need, plus you’ll meet fellow volunteers and have meaningful conversations with the voters who will decide this election.
Keep up the hard work -- and let's win this!
Jen
Jen O'Malley Dillon
Campaign Chair, Harris for President
[](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1218?utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241103_b19_jod_tier1_do_do_fl_ak-srg&t=8&akid=253%2E2563979%2EcUWKmc)

clean_body: | Peter, we’re two days out, and I wanted to send you a quick field guide for the next few days. This race continues to be extremely close. I know that can cause some anxiety. But let me just say again: We are going to win. It's just going to take every single one of us to do it. | | What We’re Seeing On the Ground We feel very, very good about where we are. More people -- and more diverse people -- are voting than ever before. We are currently on pace to turn out the voters we need to get to 50%+1 in each battleground state. We continue to have a few paths to victory: By winning the Blue Wall (Wisconsin, Michigan, and Pennsylvania), by winning the Sun Belt (Nevada, Arizona, Georgia, and North Carolina), or by winning a combination of the two. We are seeing what we need to see to pull at least one of those paths off. Volunteers knocking on doors, making calls, and making sure voters have what they need to head to the polls are making a difference in this race. So much so that undecided voters in the last week are breaking for the Vice President by double-digit margins. We know that, among the remaining pool of undecided voters, more are open to voting for the Vice President than for Trump. Our team on the ground is kicking ass reaching those voters and we have to keep it up in the days to come. What to Expect on Election Night Every state counts votes differently. Some wait until polls close, some start counting as soon as voters submit their ballot. That means that returns are going to come in for different states at different times. This is roughly what we expect to see: It will take a long time to count every single vote, and we can’t place too much stock in the early returns. The tally in certain states is going to change a lot as additional ballots are counted. For example, some states that count absentee ballots first may start off blue and shift to red as time goes on. Those would be your Michigans and Pennsylvanias. On the other hand, there are states like North Carolina, Arizona, and Nevada where we may see Republicans leading from the beginning and then those states may shift to blue as urban areas come in and more late early vote and vote-by-mail is counted. We may not know the results of this election for several days. But we must stay calm and confident during that period of time. We all have a role to play to ensure that our friends, family, and neighbors trust our electoral process. What About Trump? Look, Donald Trump is probably going to come out early on Election Night and claim victory despite the facts -- just like he did in 2020. We can count on him spinning a web of misinformation about the way this election was held and challenging the results when he loses again. It will have no impact whatsoever on the outcome of this race. Tune it out. The truth is this: Our elections are among the most transparent government processes and our systems will hold. The non-partisan decision desks at media outlets that are watching this race closely are not going to be swayed by what Donald Trump says. And we should not be either. Rest assured that if Trump and his friends try to claim they won this election and throw their bag of tricks at us, we are prepared. We have some of the best lawyers on our team and they are ready to go to court to ensure that every vote is counted. How You Can Help If that all makes you anxious, that is okay! Join the club. But let me tell you this: How you take action now will really matter come Election Night. How many doors we knock, how many phone calls we make, or how many of our neighbors we get to the polls in the coming days could determine the outcome of this election. | Our team will give you all the training you’ll need, plus you’ll meet fellow volunteers and have meaningful conversations with the voters who will decide this election. Keep up the hard work -- and let's win this! Jen Jen O'Malley Dillon Campaign Chair, Harris for President P.S. Have you voted? | | | | |

_**Because**_ I grew up in public housing with horrific conditions – as my mom worked minimum wage to support our family, I watched her struggle to make ends meet.

_**Because**_ across from our public housing building, we could see Donald Trump’s luxurious golf course – I’ve always known the striking contrast of being born into poverty or into unfathomable wealth.

_**Because**_ as a gay man of color, I know what it’s like to face discrimination and hatred. I want young folks like myself to feel supported and know that they have a place in this country – and that they can grow up and do great things.
